# Tea Tasting

A tea manufacturer decided to conduct a massive tea tasting. $$$n$$$ sorts of tea will be tasted by $$$n$$$ tasters. Both the sorts of tea and the tasters are numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$. The manufacturer prepared $$$a_i$$$ milliliters of the $$$i$$$-th sort of tea. The $$$j$$$-th taster can drink $$$b_j$$$ milliliters of tea at once.

The tasting will be conducted in steps. During the first step, the $$$i$$$-th taster tastes the $$$i$$$-th sort of tea. The $$$i$$$-th taster drinks $$$\min(a_i, b_i)$$$ tea (how much is available of the $$$i$$$-th sort and how much the $$$i$$$-th taster can drink). $$$a_i$$$ also decreases by this amount.

Then all tasters move to the previous sort of tea. Thus, during the second step, the $$$i$$$-th taster tastes the $$$(i-1)$$$-st sort of tea. The $$$i$$$-th taster drinks $$$\min(a_{i-1}, b_i)$$$ tea. The $$$1$$$-st person ends the tasting.

During the third step, the $$$i$$$-th taster tastes the $$$(i-2)$$$-nd sort of tea. The $$$2$$$-nd taster ends the tasting. This goes on until everyone ends the tasting.

Take a look at the tasting process for $$$n = 3$$$, $$$a = [10, 20, 15]$$$, $$$b = [9, 8, 6]$$$. In the left row, there are the current amounts of each sort of tea. In the right column, there are current amounts of tea each taster has drunk in total. The arrow tells which taster each tea goes to on the current step. The number on the arrow is the amount — minimum of how much is available of the sort of tea and how much the taster can drink.

![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5f2f51b15bf4d837514e7ba4b1ff1d89b7b2d4d4.png)

For each taster, print how many milliliters of tea he/she will drink in total.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of testcases.

The first line of each testcase contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of sorts of tea and the number of tasters.

The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$) — the amount of each sort of tea.

The third line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n$$$ ($$$1 \le b_i \le 10^9$$$) — the amount of tea each taster can drink at once.

The sum of $$$n$$$ over all testcases doesn't exceed $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.

## Output

For each testcase, print $$$n$$$ integers — the $$$i$$$-th value should be equal to the total amount of tea the $$$i$$$-th taster will drink.

## Note

The first testcase is described in the statement. Here are the remaining amounts of each sort of tea after each step and the total amount of tea each taster has drunk:

- $$$a = [1, 12, 9]$$$, $$$\mathit{ans} = [9, 8, 6]$$$

- $$$a = [0, 6, 9]$$$, $$$\mathit{ans} = [9, 9, 12]$$$

- $$$a = [0, 6, 9]$$$, $$$\mathit{ans} = [9, 9, 12]$$$

In the second testcase, the only taster drinks $$$\min(5, 7)$$$ milliliters of tea of the only sort.

Here are the remaining amounts of each sort of tea after each step and the total amount of tea each taster has drunk for the third testcase:

- $$$a = [10, 4, 3, 3]$$$, $$$\mathit{ans} = [3, 4, 2, 1]$$$;

- $$$a = [6, 2, 2, 3]$$$, $$$\mathit{ans} = [3, 8, 4, 2]$$$;

- $$$a = [4, 1, 2, 3]$$$, $$$\mathit{ans} = [3, 8, 6, 3]$$$;

- $$$a = [3, 1, 2, 3]$$$, $$$\mathit{ans} = [3, 8, 6, 4]$$$.

Here are the remaining amounts of each sort of tea after each step and the total amount of tea each taster has drunk for the fourth testcase:

- $$$a = [999999999, 999999999, 0]$$$, $$$\mathit{ans} = [1, 1, 1000000000]$$$;

- $$$a = [999999998, 0, 0]$$$, $$$\mathit{ans} = [1, 2, 1999999999]$$$;

- $$$a = [0, 0, 0]$$$, $$$\mathit{ans} = [1, 2, 2999999997]$$$.

# 品茶

一家茶叶制造商决定举办一场大型品茶活动。将有 $$$n$$$ 种茶由 $$$n$$$ 位品茶师品尝。茶的种类和品茶师都从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$ 编号。制造商准备了 $$$a_i$$$ 毫升的第 $$$i$$$ 种茶。第 $$$j$$$ 位品茶师一次能喝 $$$b_j$$$ 毫升茶。

品茶将分步进行。在第一步中，第 $$$i$$$ 位品茶师品尝第 $$$i$$$ 种茶。第 $$$i$$$ 位品茶师喝下 $$$\min(a_i, b_i)$$$ 茶（即第 $$$i$$$ 种茶剩余的量与第 $$$i$$$ 位品茶师能喝的量中的较小值）。$$$a_i$$$ 也减少这个量。

然后所有品茶师都转向 previous 种茶。因此，在第二步中，第 $$$i$$$ 位品茶师品尝第 $$$(i-1)$$$ 种茶。第 $$$i$$$ 位品茶师喝下 $$$\min(a_{i-1}, b_i)$$$ 茶。第 $$$1$$$ 个人结束品茶。

在第三步中，第 $$$i$$$ 位品茶师品尝第 $$$(i-2)$$$ 种茶。第 $$$2$$$ 位品茶师结束品茶。如此继续，直到每个人都结束品茶。

看看 $$$n = 3$$$、$$$a = [10, 20, 15]$$$、$$$b = [9, 8, 6]$$$ 的品茶过程。左列是每种茶当前的量。右列是每位品茶师当前总共喝下的茶量。箭头表示当前步骤中每种茶流向哪位品茶师。箭头上的数字是量——即该种茶剩余的量与品茶师能喝的量中的较小值。

![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5f2f51b15bf4d837514e7ba4b1ff1d89b7b2d4d4.png)

对于每位品茶师，输出他/她总共将喝多少毫升茶。

## 输入

第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$（$$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$（$$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$）——茶的种类数和品茶师的数量。

第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$（$$$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$）——每种茶的量。

第三行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n$$$（$$$1 \le b_i \le 10^9$$$）——每位品茶师一次能喝的茶量。

所有测试用例中 $$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。

## 输出

对于每个测试用例，输出 $$$n$$$ 个整数——第 $$$i$$$ 个值应等于第 $$$i$$$ 位品茶师总共将喝的茶量。

## 注意

第一个测试用例在题目描述中已说明。下面是其余测试用例中每一步后每种茶剩余的量和每位品尝者喝掉的总茶量：

- $$$a = [1, 12, 9]$$$，$$$\mathit{ans} = [9, 8, 6]$$$

- $$$a = [0, 6, 9]$$$，$$$\mathit{ans} = [9, 9, 12]$$$

- $$$a = [0, 6, 9]$$$，$$$\mathit{ans} = [9, 9, 12]$$$

在第二个测试用例中，唯一的品尝者喝了唯一一种茶的$$$\min(5, 7)$$$毫升。

下面是第三个测试用例中每一步后每种茶剩余的量和每位品尝者喝掉的总茶量：

- $$$a = [10, 4, 3, 3]$$$，$$$\mathit{ans} = [3, 4, 2, 1]$$$；

- $$$a = [6, 2, 2, 3]$$$，$$$\mathit{ans} = [3, 8, 4, 2]$$$；

- $$$a = [4, 1, 2, 3]$$$，$$$\mathit{ans} = [3, 8, 6, 3]$$$；

- $$$a = [3, 1, 2, 3]$$$，$$$\mathit{ans} = [3, 8, 6, 4]$$$。

下面是第四个测试用例中每一步后每种茶剩余的量和每位品尝者喝掉的总茶量：

- $$$a = [999999999, 999999999, 0]$$$，$$$\mathit{ans} = [1, 1, 1000000000]$$$；

- $$$a = [999999998, 0, 0]$$$，$$$\mathit{ans} = [1, 2, 1999999999]$$$；

- $$$a = [0, 0, 0]$$$，$$$\mathit{ans} = [1, 2, 2999999997]$$$。

# Explosions?

You are playing yet another game where you kill monsters using magic spells. There are $$$n$$$ cells in the row, numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$. Initially, the $$$i$$$-th cell contains the $$$i$$$-th monster with $$$h_i$$$ health.

You have a basic spell that costs $$$1$$$ MP and deals $$$1$$$ damage to the monster you choose. You can cast it any number of times. Also, you have a special scroll with "Explosion" spell you can use only once. You want to finish killing monsters with explosion, that's why you, firstly, cast the basic spell several times (possibly, zero), and then after that, you cast one "Explosion".

How does "Explosion" spell work? Firstly, you choose the power of the spell: if you pour $$$x$$$ MP into it, "Explosion" will deal $$$x$$$ damage. Secondly, you choose some monster $$$i$$$, which will be targeted by the spell. That's what happens next:

- if its current health $$$h_i \gt x$$$, then he stays alive with health decreased by $$$x$$$;

- if $$$h_i \le x$$$, the $$$i$$$-th monster dies with an explosion that deals $$$h_i - 1$$$ damage to monsters in the neighboring cells $$$i - 1$$$ and $$$i + 1$$$, if these cells exist and monsters inside are still alive;

- if the damage dealt by the explosion is enough to kill the monster $$$i - 1$$$ (or $$$i + 1$$$), i. e. the current $$$h_{i - 1} \le h_i - 1$$$ (or $$$h_{i + 1} \le h_i - 1$$$), then that monster also dies creating a secondary explosion of power $$$h_{i-1} - 1$$$ (or $$$h_{i+1} - 1$$$) that may deals damage to their neighbors, and so on, until the explosions end.

Your goal is to kill all the remaining monsters with those "chaining" explosions, that's why you need a basic spell to decrease $$$h_i$$$ of some monsters or even kill them beforehand (monsters die when their current health $$$h_i$$$ becomes less or equal to zero). Note that monsters don't move between cells, so, for example, monsters $$$i$$$ and $$$i + 2$$$ will never become neighbors.

What is the minimum total MP you need to kill all monsters in the way you want? The total MP is counted as the sum of the number of basic spells you cast and the power $$$x$$$ of explosion scroll you've chosen.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains the single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of cells in the row, i. e. the number of monsters.

The second line of each test case contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$h_1, h_2, \dots, h_n$$$ ($$$1 \le h_i \le 10^6$$$) — the initial health of the monsters.

It's guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases doesn't exceed $$$3 \cdot 10^5$$$.

## Output

For each test case, print one integer — the minimum total MP you need to kill all monsters by finishing them with explosion.

## Note

In the first test case, you can, for example, use basic spell on monsters $$$1$$$ and $$$2$$$ (once per monster) to kill them. After that, you cast "Explosion" of power $$$x = 1$$$ on monster $$$3$$$ to kill it. The total MP you need is $$$2 + 1 = 3$$$.

In the second test case, it's optimal to cast basic spell $$$4$$$ times onto monster $$$1$$$ to kill it. After that, you can cast "Explosion" of power $$$x = 2$$$ onto monster $$$3$$$. It dies, creating an explosion of power $$$1$$$ that kills monsters $$$2$$$ and $$$4$$$. The total MP you need is $$$4 + 2 = 6$$$.

In the third test case, you cast "Explosion" of power $$$15$$$ onto monster $$$3$$$. Explosion of the $$$3$$$-rd monster (of power $$$14$$$) kills monsters $$$2$$$ and $$$4$$$. Secondary explosion of monster $$$2$$$ (of power $$$9$$$) kills monster $$$1$$$.

# 爆炸？

你正在玩又一个使用魔法咒语击杀怪物的游戏。这一行有 $$$n$$$ 个格子，编号从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$。初始时，第 $$$i$$$ 个格子包含第 $$$i$$$ 个怪物，其生命值为 $$$h_i$$$。

你有一个基础法术，消耗 $$$1$$$ MP，并对你选择的怪物造成 $$$1$$$ 点伤害。你可以任意次数地施放它。此外，你有一张带有“Explosion”法术的特殊卷轴，只能使用一次。你想用爆炸来完成击杀怪物，因此，你首先施放基础法术若干次（可能为零次），然后在那之后，你施放一次“Explosion”。

“Explosion”法术是如何运作的？首先，你选择法术的威力：如果你向其中注入$$$x$$$ MP，那么“Explosion”将造成$$$x$$$伤害。其次，你选择某个怪物$$$i$$$，它将成为该法术的目标。接下来会发生这样的事：

- 如果它当前的生命值为 $$$h_i \gt x$$$，那么它存活下来，生命值减少 $$$x$$$；

- 如果 $$$h_i \le x$$$，则第 $$$i$$$ 只怪物会爆炸死亡，对相邻格子 $$$i - 1$$$ 和 $$$i + 1$$$ 中的怪物造成 $$$h_i - 1$$$ 点伤害，前提是这些格子存在且其中的怪物仍然存活；

- 如果爆炸造成的伤害足以杀死怪物 $$$i - 1$$$（或 $$$i + 1$$$），即当前 $$$h_{i - 1} \le h_i - 1$$$（或 $$$h_{i + 1} \le h_i - 1$$$），那么该怪物也会死亡，并产生威力为 $$$h_{i-1} - 1$$$（或 $$$h_{i+1} - 1$$$）的二次爆炸，这可能会对其邻居造成伤害，如此继续，直到爆炸结束。

你的目标是用那些“连锁”爆炸杀死所有剩余的怪物，因此你需要一个基础法术来降低某些怪物的 $$$h_i$$$，甚至提前杀死它们（当怪物的当前生命值 $$$h_i$$$ 变为小于或等于零时，怪物死亡）。注意怪物不会在格子之间移动，因此，例如怪物 $$$i$$$ 和 $$$i + 2$$$ 永远不会成为邻居。

为了按你希望的方式杀死所有怪物，你最少需要多少总 MP？总 MP 计为你施放的基础法术数量与你选择的爆炸卷轴威力 $$$x$$$ 之和。

## 输入

第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$（$$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例的第一行包含单个整数 $$$n$$$（$$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$）——这一行中的单元格数量，即怪物的数量。

每个测试用例的第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$h_1, h_2, \dots, h_n$$$（$$$1 \le h_i \le 10^6$$$）——怪物的初始生命值。

保证所有测试用例中 $$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$3 \cdot 10^5$$$。

## 输出

对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数——通过爆炸击杀所有怪物所需的最小总 MP。

## 提示

在第一个测试用例中，例如，你可以对怪物 $$$1$$$ 和 $$$2$$$ 使用基础法术（每个怪物一次）来杀死它们。之后，你对怪物 $$$3$$$ 施放威力为 $$$x = 1$$$ 的“爆炸”来杀死它。你需要的总 MP 为 $$$2 + 1 = 3$$$。

在第二个测试用例中，最优做法是对怪物 $$$1$$$ 施放基础法术 $$$4$$$ 次来杀死它。之后，你可以对怪物 $$$3$$$ 施放威力为 $$$x = 2$$$ 的“爆炸”。它死亡时产生威力为 $$$1$$$ 的爆炸，杀死怪物 $$$2$$$ 和 $$$4$$$。你需要的总 MP 为 $$$4 + 2 = 6$$$。

在第三个测试用例中，你对怪物 $$$3$$$ 施放威力为 $$$15$$$ 的“爆炸”。第 $$$3$$$ 个怪物的爆炸（威力为 $$$14$$$）杀死怪物 $$$2$$$ 和 $$$4$$$。怪物 $$$2$$$ 的二次爆炸（威力为 $$$9$$$）杀死怪物 $$$1$$$。

# Two Tanks

There are two water tanks, the first one fits $$$a$$$ liters of water, the second one fits $$$b$$$ liters of water. The first tank has $$$c$$$ ($$$0 \le c \le a$$$) liters of water initially, the second tank has $$$d$$$ ($$$0 \le d \le b$$$) liters of water initially.

You want to perform $$$n$$$ operations on them. The $$$i$$$-th operation is specified by a single non-zero integer $$$v_i$$$. If $$$v_i \gt 0$$$, then you try to pour $$$v_i$$$ liters of water from the first tank into the second one. If $$$v_i \lt 0$$$, you try to pour $$$-v_i$$$ liters of water from the second tank to the first one.

When you try to pour $$$x$$$ liters of water from the tank that has $$$y$$$ liters currently available to the tank that can fit $$$z$$$ more liters of water, the operation only moves $$$\min(x, y, z)$$$ liters of water.

For all pairs of the initial volumes of water $$$(c, d)$$$ such that $$$0 \le c \le a$$$ and $$$0 \le d \le b$$$, calculate the volume of water in the first tank after all operations are performed.

## Input

The first line contains three integers $$$n, a$$$ and $$$b$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^4$$$; $$$1 \le a, b \le 1000$$$) — the number of operations and the capacities of the tanks, respectively.

The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$v_1, v_2, \dots, v_n$$$ ($$$-1000 \le v_i \le 1000$$$; $$$v_i \neq 0$$$) — the volume of water you try to pour in each operation.

## Output

For all pairs of the initial volumes of water $$$(c, d)$$$ such that $$$0 \le c \le a$$$ and $$$0 \le d \le b$$$, calculate the volume of water in the first tank after all operations are performed.

Print $$$a + 1$$$ lines, each line should contain $$$b + 1$$$ integers. The $$$j$$$-th value in the $$$i$$$-th line should be equal to the answer for $$$c = i - 1$$$ and $$$d = j - 1$$$.

## Note

Consider $$$c = 3$$$ and $$$d = 2$$$ from the first example:

- The first operation tries to move $$$2$$$ liters of water from the second tank to the first one, the second tank has $$$2$$$ liters available, the first tank can fit $$$1$$$ more liter. Thus, $$$\min(2, 2, 1) = 1$$$ liter is moved, the first tank now contains $$$4$$$ liters, the second tank now contains $$$1$$$ liter.

- The second operation tries to move $$$1$$$ liter of water from the first tank to the second one. $$$\min(1, 4, 3) = 1$$$ liter is moved, the first tank now contains $$$3$$$ liters, the second tank now contains $$$2$$$ liter.

- The third operation tries to move $$$2$$$ liter of water from the first tank to the second one. $$$\min(2, 3, 2) = 2$$$ liters are moved, the first tank now contains $$$1$$$ liter, the second tank now contains $$$4$$$ liters.

There's $$$1$$$ liter of water in the first tank at the end. Thus, the third value in the fourth row is $$$1$$$.

# 两个水箱

有两个水箱，第一个能装$$$a$$$升水，第二个能装$$$b$$$升水。第一个水箱初始有$$$c$$$（$$$0 \le c \le a$$$）升水，第二个水箱初始有$$$d$$$（$$$0 \le d \le b$$$）升水。

你想对它们执行$$$n$$$次操作。第$$$i$$$次操作由一个非零整数$$$v_i$$$指定。如果$$$v_i \gt 0$$$，那么你尝试从第一个水箱向第二个水箱倒入$$$v_i$$$升水。如果$$$v_i \lt 0$$$，你尝试从第二个水箱向第一个水箱倒入$$$-v_i$$$升水。

当你尝试从当前有$$$y$$$升可用水的水箱向还能多装$$$z$$$升水的水箱倒入$$$x$$$升水时，该操作只会移动$$$\min(x, y, z)$$$升水。

对于所有满足$$$0 \le c \le a$$$和$$$0 \le d \le b$$$的初始水量对$$$(c, d)$$$，计算所有操作完成后第一个水箱中的水量。

## 输入

第一行包含三个整数$$$n, a$$$和$$$b$$$（$$$1 \le n \le 10^4$$$；$$$1 \le a, b \le 1000$$$）——分别是操作次数和水箱容量。

第二行包含$$$n$$$个整数$$$v_1, v_2, \dots, v_n$$$（$$$-1000 \le v_i \le 1000$$$；$$$v_i \neq 0$$$）——每次操作中你尝试倒入的水量。

## 输出

对于所有满足$$$0 \le c \le a$$$和$$$0 \le d \le b$$$的初始水量对$$$(c, d)$$$，计算所有操作完成后第一个水箱中的水量。

输出$$$a + 1$$$行，每行应包含$$$b + 1$$$个整数。第$$$i$$$行中的第$$$j$$$个值应等于$$$c = i - 1$$$和$$$d = j - 1$$$对应的答案。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例中的$$$c = 3$$$和$$$d = 2$$$：

- 第一次操作尝试从第二个水箱向第一个水箱移动$$$2$$$升水，第二个水箱有$$$2$$$升可用水，第一个水箱还能多装$$$1$$$升。因此，移动了$$$\min(2, 2, 1) = 1$$$升，第一个水箱现在含有$$$4$$$升，第二个水箱现在含有$$$1$$$升。

- 第二次操作尝试从第一个水箱向第二个水箱移动$$$1$$$升水。$$$\min(1, 4, 3) = 1$$$ 升水被移动，第一个水箱现在含有 $$$3$$$ 升水，第二个水箱现在含有 $$$2$$$ 升水。

- 第三次操作尝试将 $$$2$$$ 升水从第一个水箱移动到第二个水箱。$$$\min(2, 3, 2) = 2$$$ 升水被移动，第一个水箱现在含有 $$$1$$$ 升水，第二个水箱现在含有 $$$4$$$ 升水。

最后第一个水箱中有 $$$1$$$ 升水。因此，第四行中的第三个值是 $$$1$$$。

# 并行搜索

假设你有 $$$n$$$ 个盒子。第 $$$i$$$ 个盒子中装有无限多个颜色为 $$$i$$$ 的球。有时你需要取出某个特定颜色的球；但你太懒了，不想自己去做。

你买了两个机器人来帮你取球。现在你必须为它们编程。为了给机器人编程，你必须构造两个列表 $$$[a_1, a_2, \dots, a_k]$$$ 和 $$$[b_1, b_2, \dots, b_{n-k}]$$$，其中列表 $$$a$$$ 表示分配给第一个机器人的盒子，列表 $$$b$$$ 表示分配给第二个机器人的盒子。从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$ 的每个整数都必须恰好出现在这两个列表中的一个里。

当你请求一个颜色为 $$$x$$$ 的球时，机器人按如下方式工作。每个机器人按照其列表中盒子的顺序依次检查分配给它的盒子。第一个机器人分析一个盒子的内容需要花费 $$$s_1$$$ 秒；第二个机器人需要花费 $$$s_2$$$ 秒。一旦其中一个机器人找到装有颜色为 $$$x$$$ 的球的盒子（并分析其内容），搜索就结束。搜索时间是从搜索开始到其中一个机器人完成分析第 $$$x$$$ 个盒子内容所经过的秒数。如果一个机器人分析完分配给它的所有盒子，它就停止搜索。

例如，假设 $$$s_1 = 2$$$，$$$s_2 = 3$$$，$$$a = [4, 1, 5, 3, 7]$$$，$$$b = [2, 6]$$$。如果你请求一个颜色为 $$$3$$$ 的球，会发生以下情况：

- 最初，第一个机器人开始分析盒子 $$$4$$$，第二个机器人开始分析盒子 $$$2$$$；

- 在第 $$$2$$$ 秒结束时，第一个机器人完成分析盒子 $$$4$$$。这不是你需要的盒子，所以该机器人继续分析盒子 $$$1$$$；

- 在第 $$$3$$$ 秒结束时，第二个机器人完成分析盒子 $$$2$$$。这不是你需要的盒子，所以该机器人继续分析盒子 $$$6$$$；

- 在第 $$$4$$$ 秒结束时，第一个机器人完成分析盒子 $$$1$$$。这不是你需要的盒子，所以该机器人继续分析盒子 $$$5$$$；

- 在第 $$$6$$$ 秒结束时，第一个机器人完成分析盒子 $$$5$$$。这不是你需要的盒子，所以该机器人继续分析盒子 $$$3$$$。与此同时，第二个机器人完成分析盒子 $$$6$$$。这不是你需要的盒子，并且第二个机器人已经分析完其列表中的所有盒子，因此该机器人停止搜索；

- 在第 $$$8$$$ 秒结束时，第一个机器人完成了对盒子 $$$3$$$ 的分析。这正是你需要的盒子，因此搜索结束；

- 因此，搜索时间为 $$$8$$$ 秒。

你知道你将请求颜色 $$$1$$$ 的球 $$$r_1$$$ 次，颜色 $$$2$$$ 的球 $$$r_2$$$ 次，依此类推。你希望为机器人构造列表 $$$a$$$ 和 $$$b$$$，使得所有请求的总搜索时间尽可能小。

## 输入

第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$（$$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例由两行组成：

- 第一行包含三个整数 $$$n$$$、$$$s_1$$$、$$$s_2$$$（$$$2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$；$$$1 \le s_1, s_2 \le 10$$$）；

- 第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$r_1, r_2, \dots, r_n$$$（$$$1 \le r_i \le 10^6$$$）。

输入的附加约束：所有测试用例中 $$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。

## 输出

对于每个测试用例，输出两行。第一行应包含列表 $$$a$$$，第二行——列表 $$$b$$$。每个列表的打印方式如下：首先打印其中元素的数量，然后打印元素本身。

如果有多个答案，你可以输出其中任意一个。

# Balancing Weapons

You've got a job in a game studio that developed an online shooter, and your first big task is to help to balance weapons. The game has $$$n$$$ weapons: the $$$i$$$-th gun has an integer fire rate $$$f_i$$$ and an integer damage per bullet $$$d_i$$$. The $$$i$$$-th gun's total firepower is equal to $$$p_i = f_i \cdot d_i$$$.

You have to modify the values $$$d_i$$$ of some guns in such a way that the new values $$$d_i$$$ will still be integers, and the firepower of all guns will become balanced. Given an integer $$$k$$$, the guns are said to be balanced if $$$\max\limits_{1 \le i \le n}{p_i} - \min\limits_{1 \le i \le n}{p_i} \le k$$$.

Since gamers that play your game don't like big changes, you need to change the values $$$d_i$$$ for the minimum possible number of guns. What is the minimum number of guns for which you have to change these values to make the guns balanced?

Note that the new values $$$d_i$$$ must be integers greater than $$$0$$$.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 1000$$$) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 3000$$$; $$$0 \le k \le 1500$$$) — the number of guns to balance, and the maximum allowed gap between the most and the least powerful weapons.

The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$f_1, f_2, \dots, f_n$$$ ($$$1 \le f_i \le 2000$$$), where $$$f_i$$$ is the fire rate of the $$$i$$$-th gun.

The third line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_n$$$ ($$$1 \le d_i \le 10^9$$$), where $$$d_i$$$ is the damage per bullet of the $$$i$$$-th gun.

It's guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases doesn't exceed $$$3000$$$.

## Output

For each test case, print the minimum number of guns which damage $$$d_i$$$ you have to change in order to make the guns balanced.

Note that the new values $$$d_i$$$ must be integers greater than $$$0$$$.

## Note

In the first test case, you can set $$$d_1 = 2$$$ and $$$d_2 = 4$$$. You'll get an array $$$d = [2, 4, 1, 2]$$$, and the values of firepower will be $$$p = [12, 12, 13, 14]$$$. The guns are balanced, since $$$14 - 12 \le 2$$$.

In the second test case, you have to change the value $$$d_i$$$ for all three guns. For example, you can set $$$d = [5151, 5100, 5050]$$$.

In the third test case, all guns are already balanced, so you don't have to change anything.

# 平衡武器

你在一家开发在线射击游戏的游戏工作室工作，你的第一个大任务是帮助平衡武器。游戏中有 $$$n$$$ 把武器：第 $$$i$$$ 把枪的射速为整数 $$$f_i$$$，每发子弹的伤害为整数 $$$d_i$$$。第 $$$i$$$ 把枪的总火力等于 $$$p_i = f_i \cdot d_i$$$。

你必须修改某些枪的 $$$d_i$$$ 值，使得新的 $$$d_i$$$ 值仍然是整数，并且所有枪的火力变得平衡。给定一个整数 $$$k$$$，如果 $$$\max\limits_{1 \le i \le n}{p_i} - \min\limits_{1 \le i \le n}{p_i} \le k$$$，则称这些枪是平衡的。

由于玩你的游戏的玩家不喜欢大的改动，你需要用尽可能少的枪数来修改 $$$d_i$$$ 值。为了使枪平衡，你最少需要修改多少把枪的这些值？

注意，新的 $$$d_i$$$ 值必须是大于 $$$0$$$ 的整数。

## 输入

第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$（$$$1 \le t \le 1000$$$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数 $$$n$$$ 和 $$$k$$$（$$$2 \le n \le 3000$$$；$$$0 \le k \le 1500$$$）——要平衡的枪的数量，以及最强和最弱武器之间允许的最大差距。

第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$f_1, f_2, \dots, f_n$$$（$$$1 \le f_i \le 2000$$$），其中 $$$f_i$$$ 是第 $$$i$$$ 把枪的射速。

第三行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_n$$$（$$$1 \le d_i \le 10^9$$$），其中 $$$d_i$$$ 是第 $$$i$$$ 把枪每发子弹的伤害。

保证所有测试用例中 $$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$3000$$$。

## 输出

对于每个测试用例，输出为了使枪平衡，你最少需要修改多少把枪的伤害 $$$d_i$$$。

注意，新的 $$$d_i$$$ 值必须是大于 $$$0$$$ 的整数。

## 提示

在第一个测试用例中，你可以设置 $$$d_1 = 2$$$ 和 $$$d_2 = 4$$$。你将得到数组 $$$d = [2, 4, 1, 2]$$$，火力值将为 $$$p = [12, 12, 13, 14]$$$。这些枪是平衡的，因为 $$$14 - 12 \le 2$$$。

在第二个测试用例中，你必须修改所有三把枪的 $$$d_i$$$ 值。例如，你可以设置 $$$d = [5151, 5100, 5050]$$$。

在第三个测试用例中，所有枪已经平衡，因此你不需要修改任何东西。

# 黑色单元格

你正在玩一条非常长的条带，它由$$$10^{18}$$$个白色单元格组成，从左到右编号为$$$0$$$、$$$1$$$、$$$2$$$，依此类推。你控制着一个特殊的指针，初始位于单元格$$$0$$$。此外，你有一个可以按下并保持的“Shift”按钮。

在一次移动中，你可以执行以下三种操作之一：

- 将指针向右移动（从单元格$$$x$$$移动到单元格$$$x + 1$$$）；

- 按下并保持“Shift”按钮；

- 释放“Shift”按钮：在你释放“Shift”的那一刻，所有在按住“Shift”期间访问过的单元格都会被涂成黑色。

（当然，如果你已经按住了Shift，就不能再按它。同样，如果你还没有按下Shift，就不能释放它。）

你的目标是给至少$$$k$$$个单元格涂色，但有一个限制：给定$$$n$$$个区间$$$[l_i, r_i]$$$——你只能在那些区间内给单元格涂色，也就是说，当且仅当对于某个$$$i$$$有$$$l_i \le x \le r_i$$$时，你才能给单元格$$$x$$$涂色。

为了给至少$$$k$$$个单元格涂成黑色，你最少需要执行多少次移动？

## 输入

第一行包含一个整数$$$t$$$（$$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数$$$n$$$和$$$k$$$（$$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$；$$$1 \le k \le 10^9$$$）——分别是区间的数量和期望的黑色单元格数量。

第二行包含$$$n$$$个整数$$$l_1, l_2, \dots, l_n$$$（$$$1 \le l_1 \lt l_2 \lt \dots \lt l_n \le 10^9$$$），其中$$$l_i$$$是第$$$i$$$个区间的左边界。

第三行包含$$$n$$$个整数$$$r_1, r_2, \dots, r_n$$$（$$$1 \le r_i \le 10^9$$$；$$$l_i \le r_i \lt l_{i + 1} - 1$$$），其中$$$r_i$$$是第$$$i$$$个区间的右边界。

输入的额外约束：

- 每个单元格至多属于一个区间；

- $$$n$$$的总和不超过$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。

## 输出

对于每个测试用例，输出给至少$$$k$$$个单元格涂成黑色所需的最少移动次数，如果不可能则输出$$$-1$$$。

## 说明

在第一个测试用例中，一种最优操作序列如下：

- 向右移动：指针移入单元格$$$1$$$；

- 按下Shift；

- 释放 Shift：单元格 $$$1$$$ 被染成黑色；

- 向右移动：指针正在移入单元格 $$$2$$$；

- 向右移动：指针正移入单元格 $$$3$$$；

- 按 Shift 键；

- 向右移动：指针正在移入单元格 $$$4$$$；

- 释放位移：格子 $$$3$$$ 和 $$$4$$$ 被染成黑色。

我们将 $$$3$$$ 个格子用 $$$8$$$ 次操作染色。

在第二个测试用例中，我们最多可以给 $$$8$$$ 个单元格着色，而我们需要给 $$$20$$$ 个单元格着色。

在第三个测试用例中，其中一个最优操作序列如下：

- 向右移动：指针正在移入单元格 $$$1$$$；

- 向右移动：指针正在移入单元格 $$$2$$$；

- 向右移动：指针正移入单元格 $$$3$$$；

- 按 Shift 键；

- 向右移动：指针正移入单元格 $$$4$$$；

- 向右移动：指针正移入单元格 $$$5$$$；

- 释放位移：格子 $$$3$$$、$$$4$$$ 和 $$$5$$$ 被染成黑色。

我们将 $$$3$$$ 个格子用 $$$7$$$ 次操作染色。

# Zombies

Polycarp plays a computer game in a post-apocalyptic setting. The zombies have taken over the world, and Polycarp with a small team of survivors is defending against hordes trying to invade their base. The zombies are invading for $$$x$$$ minutes starting from minute $$$0$$$. There are $$$n$$$ entrances to the base, and every minute one zombie attempts to enter through every entrance.

The survivors can defend the entrances against the zombies. There are two options:

- manually — shoot the zombies coming through a certain entrance;

- automatically — set up an electric fence on a certain entrance to fry the zombies.

If an entrance is defended either or both ways during some minute, no zombie goes through.

Every entrance is defended by a single dedicated survivor. The $$$i$$$-th entrance is defended manually from minute $$$l_i$$$ until minute $$$r_i$$$, non-inclusive — $$$[l_i, r_i)$$$.

There are $$$k$$$ generators that can be used to defend the entrances automatically. Every entrance should be connected to exactly one generator, but a generator can be connected to multiple entrances (or even none of them). Each generator will work for exactly $$$m$$$ consecutive minutes. Polycarp can choose when to power on each generator independently of each other, the $$$m$$$ minute long interval should be fully inside the $$$[0, x)$$$ time interval.

Polycarp is a weird gamer. He wants the game to be as difficult as possible for him. So he wants to connect each entrance to a generator and choose the time for each generator in such a way that as many zombies as possible enter the base. Please, help him to achieve that!

## Input

The first line contains four integers $$$n, k, x$$$ and $$$m$$$ ($$$1 \le k \le n \le 2000$$$; $$$1 \le m \le x \le 10^9$$$) — the number of entrances, the number of generators, the duration of the zombie invasion and the duration of all generators.

The $$$i$$$-th of the next $$$n$$$ lines contains two integers $$$l_i$$$ and $$$r_i$$$ ($$$0 \le l_i \lt r_i \le x$$$) — the time interval the $$$i$$$-th entrance is defended manually.

## Output

Print a single integer — the largest number of zombies that can enter the base after Polycarp connects each entrance to some generator and chooses the time for each generator.

# Zombies

Polycarp 在一个后末日背景的电脑游戏中游玩。僵尸已经占领了世界，Polycarp 和一小队幸存者正在抵御试图入侵他们基地的僵尸群。僵尸入侵持续 $$$x$$$ 分钟，从第 $$$0$$$ 分钟开始。基地有 $$$n$$$ 个入口，每分钟都有一只僵尸试图通过每个入口进入。

幸存者可以防御入口以对抗僵尸。有两种选择：

- 手动——射击通过某个入口的僵尸；

- 自动——在某个入口设置电围栏来电死僵尸。

如果某个入口在某一分钟内以任一方式或两种方式被防御，则没有僵尸通过。

每个入口由一名专门的幸存者防御。第 $$$i$$$ 个入口从第 $$$l_i$$$ 分钟到第 $$$r_i$$$ 分钟（不包含）被手动防御——即 $$$[l_i, r_i)$$$。

有 $$$k$$$ 台发电机可用于自动防御入口。每个入口应恰好连接到一台发电机，但一台发电机可以连接到多个入口（甚至可以不连接任何入口）。每台发电机将恰好工作 $$$m$$$ 个连续分钟。Polycarp 可以独立选择每台发电机的开启时间，这 $$$m$$$ 分钟长的区间应完全位于 $$$[0, x)$$$ 时间区间内。

Polycarp 是一个奇怪的玩家。他想让游戏对他来说尽可能困难。因此，他想将每个入口连接到一台发电机，并为每台发电机选择时间，使得尽可能多的僵尸进入基地。请帮助他实现这一点！

## 输入

第一行包含四个整数 $$$n, k, x$$$ 和 $$$m$$$（$$$1 \le k \le n \le 2000$$$；$$$1 \le m \le x \le 10^9$$$）——入口数量、发电机数量、僵尸入侵持续时间和所有发电机的持续时间。

接下来 $$$n$$$ 行中的第 $$$i$$$ 行包含两个整数 $$$l_i$$$ 和 $$$r_i$$$（$$$0 \le l_i \lt r_i \le x$$$）——第 $$$i$$$ 个入口被手动防御的时间区间。

## 输出

输出一个整数——在 Polycarp 将每个入口连接到某台发电机并为每台发电机选择时间后，能够进入基地的僵尸的最大数量。

# Playoff Fixing

$$$2^k$$$ teams participate in a playoff tournament. The teams are numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$2^k$$$, in order of decreasing strength. So, team $$$1$$$ is the strongest one, team $$$2^k$$$ is the weakest one. A team with a smaller number always defeats a team with a larger number.

First of all, the teams are arranged in some order during a procedure called seeding. Each team is assigned another unique value from $$$1$$$ to $$$2^k$$$, called a seed, that represents its starting position in the playoff.

The tournament consists of $$$2^k - 1$$$ games. They are held as follows: the teams are split into pairs: team with seed $$$1$$$ plays against team with seed $$$2$$$, team with seed $$$3$$$ plays against team with seed $$$4$$$ (exactly in this order), and so on (so, $$$2^{k-1}$$$ games are played in that phase). When a team loses a game, it is eliminated.

After that, only $$$2^{k-1}$$$ teams remain. If only one team remains, it is declared the champion; otherwise, $$$2^{k-2}$$$ games are played: in the first one of them, the winner of the game "seed $$$1$$$ vs seed $$$2$$$" plays against the winner of the game "seed $$$3$$$ vs seed $$$4$$$", then the winner of the game "seed $$$5$$$ vs seed $$$6$$$" plays against the winner of the game "seed $$$7$$$ vs seed $$$8$$$", and so on. This process repeats until only one team remains.

After the tournament ends, the teams are assigned places according to the tournament phase when they were eliminated. In particular:

- the winner of the tournament gets place $$$1$$$;

- the team eliminated in the finals gets place $$$2$$$;

- both teams eliminated in the semifinals get place $$$3$$$;

- all teams eliminated in the quarterfinals get place $$$5$$$;

- all teams eliminated in the 1/8 finals get place $$$9$$$, and so on.

Now that we established the rules, we do a little rigging. In particular, we want:

- team $$$1$$$ (not team with seed $$$1$$$) to take place $$$1$$$;

- team $$$2$$$ to take place $$$2$$$;

- teams $$$3$$$ and $$$4$$$ to take place $$$3$$$;

- teams from $$$5$$$ to $$$8$$$ to take place $$$5$$$, and so on.

For example, this picture describes one of the possible ways the tournament can go with $$$k = 3$$$, and the resulting places of the teams:

![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8fab1b9637d97dbe907d742f5faef2e1bc7ca408.png)

Some seeds are already reserved for some teams (we are not the only ones rigging the tournament, apparently). We have to fill the rest of the seeds with the remaining teams to achieve the desired placements. How many ways are there to do that? Since that value might be large, print it modulo $$$998\,244\,353$$$.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $$$k$$$ ($$$0 \le k \le 19$$$) — there are $$$2^k$$$ teams.

The second line contains $$$2^k$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_{2^k}$$$ ($$$a_i = -1$$$ or $$$1 \le a_i \le 2^k$$$). If $$$a_i \ne -1$$$, then team $$$a_i$$$ has seed $$$i$$$. Otherwise, the seed $$$i$$$ is not reserved for any team.

All values, that are not $$$-1$$$, are distinct.

## Output

Print a single integer — the number of ways to fill the non-reserved seeds so that the tournament goes as planned, modulo $$$998\,244\,353$$$.
content.title: Playoff Fixing

# 季后赛排位修正

$$$2^k$$$ 支队伍参加一场季后赛锦标赛。队伍按实力递减的顺序从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$2^k$$$ 编号。因此，队伍 $$$1$$$ 是最强的，队伍 $$$2^k$$$ 是最弱的。编号较小的队伍总是战胜编号较大的队伍。

首先，在一个称为排位的过程中，队伍按某种顺序排列。每支队伍被分配另一个从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$2^k$$$ 的唯一值，称为排位号，表示其在季后赛中的起始位置。

锦标赛由 $$$2^k - 1$$$ 场比赛组成。比赛进行方式如下：队伍被分成对：排位号为 $$$1$$$ 的队伍对阵排位号为 $$$2$$$ 的队伍，排位号为 $$$3$$$ 的队伍对阵排位号为 $$$4$$$ 的队伍（严格按此顺序），依此类推（因此，该阶段进行 $$$2^{k-1}$$$ 场比赛）。当一支队伍输掉一场比赛时，它被淘汰。

之后，只剩下 $$$2^{k-1}$$$ 支队伍。如果只剩下一支队伍，它被宣布为冠军；否则，进行 $$$2^{k-2}$$$ 场比赛：其中第一场，“排位号 $$$1$$$ 对阵排位号 $$$2$$$”比赛的胜者对阵“排位号 $$$3$$$ 对阵排位号 $$$4$$$”比赛的胜者，然后“排位号 $$$5$$$ 对阵排位号 $$$6$$$”比赛的胜者对阵“排位号 $$$7$$$ 对阵排位号 $$$8$$$”比赛的胜者，依此类推。此过程重复，直到只剩下一支队伍。

锦标赛结束后，根据队伍被淘汰时所处的锦标赛阶段为其分配名次。具体来说：

- 锦标赛的冠军获得名次 $$$1$$$；

- 在决赛中被淘汰的队伍获得名次 $$$2$$$；

- 在半决赛中被淘汰的两支队伍获得名次 $$$3$$$；

- 在四分之一决赛中被淘汰的所有队伍获得名次 $$$5$$$；

- 在 1/8 决赛中被淘汰的所有队伍获得名次 $$$9$$$，依此类推。

既然我们已经确立了规则，我们来做一点操纵。具体来说，我们希望：

- 队伍 $$$1$$$（不是排位号为 $$$1$$$ 的队伍）获得名次 $$$1$$$；

- 队伍 $$$2$$$ 获得名次 $$$2$$$；

- 队伍 $$$3$$$ 和 $$$4$$$ 获得名次 $$$3$$$；

- 从 $$$5$$$ 到 $$$8$$$ 的队伍获得名次 $$$5$$$，依此类推。

例如，这张图片描述了当 $$$k = 3$$$ 时锦标赛可能进行的一种方式，以及各队的最终名次：

![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8fab1b9637d97dbe907d742f5faef2e1bc7ca408.png)

有些种子位置已经被某些队伍预定了（显然，不是只有我们在操纵锦标赛）。我们必须用剩下的队伍填满其余的种子位置，以达到期望的名次。有多少种方法可以做到这一点？由于这个值可能很大，请对 $$$998\,244\,353$$$ 取模后输出。

## 输入

第一行包含一个整数 $$$k$$$（$$$0 \le k \le 19$$$）——共有 $$$2^k$$$ 支队伍。

第二行包含 $$$2^k$$$ 个整数 $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_{2^k}$$$（$$$a_i = -1$$$ 或 $$$1 \le a_i \le 2^k$$$）。如果 $$$a_i \ne -1$$$，那么队伍 $$$a_i$$$ 拥有种子位置 $$$i$$$。否则，种子位置 $$$i$$$ 没有被任何队伍预定。

所有不为 $$$-1$$$ 的值都互不相同。

## 输出

输出一个整数——填满未预定的种子位置以使锦标赛按计划进行的方法数，对 $$$998\,244\,353$$$ 取模。

# Game with Board

Alice and Bob play a game. They have a blackboard; initially, there are $$$n$$$ integers written on it, and each integer is equal to $$$1$$$.

Alice and Bob take turns; Alice goes first. On their turn, the player has to choose several (at least two) equal integers on the board, wipe them and write a new integer which is equal to their sum.

For example, if the board currently contains integers $$$\{1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3\}$$$, then the following moves are possible:

- choose two integers equal to $$$1$$$, wipe them and write an integer $$$2$$$, then the board becomes $$$\{2, 2, 2, 2, 3\}$$$;

- choose two integers equal to $$$2$$$, wipe them and write an integer $$$4$$$, then the board becomes $$$\{1, 1, 2, 3, 4\}$$$;

- choose three integers equal to $$$2$$$, wipe them and write an integer $$$6$$$, then the board becomes $$$\{1, 1, 3, 6\}$$$.

If a player cannot make a move (all integers on the board are different), that player wins the game.

Determine who wins if both players play optimally.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 99$$$) — the number of test cases.

Each test case consists of one line containing one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 100$$$) — the number of integers equal to $$$1$$$ on the board.

## Output

For each test case, print `Alice` if Alice wins when both players play optimally. Otherwise, print `Bob`.

## Note

In the first test case, $$$n = 3$$$, so the board initially contains integers $$$\{1, 1, 1\}$$$. We can show that Bob can always win as follows: there are two possible first moves for Alice.

- if Alice chooses two integers equal to $$$1$$$, wipes them and writes $$$2$$$, the board becomes $$$\{1, 2\}$$$. Bob cannot make a move, so he wins;

- if Alice chooses three integers equal to $$$1$$$, wipes them and writes $$$3$$$, the board becomes $$$\{3\}$$$. Bob cannot make a move, so he wins.

In the second test case, $$$n = 6$$$, so the board initially contains integers $$$\{1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1\}$$$. Alice can win by, for example, choosing two integers equal to $$$1$$$, wiping them and writing $$$2$$$ on the first turn. Then the board becomes $$$\{1, 1, 1, 1, 2\}$$$, and there are three possible responses for Bob:

- if Bob chooses four integers equal to $$$1$$$, wipes them and writes $$$4$$$, the board becomes $$$\{2,4\}$$$. Alice cannot make a move, so she wins;

- if Bob chooses three integers equal to $$$1$$$, wipes them and writes $$$3$$$, the board becomes $$$\{1,2,3\}$$$. Alice cannot make a move, so she wins;

- if Bob chooses two integers equal to $$$1$$$, wipes them and writes $$$2$$$, the board becomes $$$\{1, 1, 2, 2\}$$$. Alice can continue by, for example, choosing two integers equal to $$$2$$$, wiping them and writing $$$4$$$. Then the board becomes $$$\{1,1,4\}$$$. The only possible response for Bob is to choose two integers equal to $$$1$$$ and write $$$2$$$ instead of them; then the board becomes $$$\{2,4\}$$$, Alice cannot make a move, so she wins.

# 保持美丽

数组 $$$[a_1, a_2, \dots, a_k]$$$ 被称为美丽的，如果可以从数组开头移除若干（可能为零）个元素，并按相同顺序将这些元素全部插入到数组末尾，使得结果数组按非降序排序。

换句话说，如果存在一个整数 $$$i \in [0, k-1]$$$，使得数组 $$$[a_{i+1}, a_{i+2}, \dots, a_{k-1}, a_k, a_1, a_2, \dots, a_i]$$$ 按非降序排序，那么数组 $$$[a_1, a_2, \dots, a_k]$$$ 就是美丽的。

例如：

- $$$[3, 7, 7, 9, 2, 3]$$$ 是美丽的：我们可以移除前四个元素，并按相同顺序将它们插入到末尾，得到数组 $$$[2, 3, 3, 7, 7, 9]$$$，该数组按非降序排序；

- $$$[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]$$$ 是美丽的：我们可以移除零个首元素并将它们插入到末尾，得到数组 $$$[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]$$$，它是按非降序排序的；

- $$$[5, 2, 2, 1]$$$ 不是美丽的。

请注意，任何由零个元素或一个元素组成的数组都是美丽的。

给定一个数组 $$$a$$$，它最初为空。你需要对它处理 $$$q$$$ 次查询。在第 $$$i$$$ 次查询中，你会得到一个整数 $$$x_i$$$，并且你需要执行以下操作：

- 如果你可以将整数 $$$x_i$$$ 追加到数组 $$$a$$$ 的末尾，使得数组 $$$a$$$ 保持美丽，你就必须追加它；

- 否则，什么都不做。

每次查询后，报告你是否追加了给定的整数 $$$x_i$$$。

## 输入

第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$（$$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例由两行组成。第一行包含一个整数 $$$q$$$（$$$1 \le q \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$）——查询的数量。第二行包含 $$$q$$$ 个整数 $$$x_1, x_2, \dots, x_q$$$（$$$0 \le x_i \le 10^9$$$）。

输入上的附加约束：所有测试用例中 $$$q$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$）。

对于每个测试用例，输出一个恰好包含 $$$q$$$ 个字符的字符串。如果在第 $$$i$$$ 次查询时你追加了该整数，则该字符串的第 $$$i$$$ 个字符应为 `1`；否则应为 `0`。

## 注意

考虑示例的第一个测试用例。初始时，数组为 $$$[]$$$。

# Pairs of Segments

Two segments $$$[l_1, r_1]$$$ and $$$[l_2, r_2]$$$ intersect if there exists at least one $$$x$$$ such that $$$l_1 \le x \le r_1$$$ and $$$l_2 \le x \le r_2$$$.

An array of segments $$$[[l_1, r_1], [l_2, r_2], \dots, [l_k, r_k]]$$$ is called beautiful if $$$k$$$ is even, and is possible to split the elements of this array into $$$\frac{k}{2}$$$ pairs in such a way that:

- every element of the array belongs to exactly one of the pairs;

- segments in each pair intersect with each other;

- segments in different pairs do not intersect.

For example, the array $$$[[2, 4], [9, 12], [2, 4], [7, 7], [10, 13], [6, 8]]$$$ is beautiful, since it is possible to form $$$3$$$ pairs as follows:

- the first element of the array (segment $$$[2, 4]$$$) and the third element of the array (segment $$$[2, 4]$$$);

- the second element of the array (segment $$$[9, 12]$$$) and the fifth element of the array (segment $$$[10, 13]$$$);

- the fourth element of the array (segment $$$[7, 7]$$$) and the sixth element of the array (segment $$$[6, 8]$$$).

As you can see, the segments in each pair intersect, and no segments from different pairs intersect.

You are given an array of $$$n$$$ segments $$$[[l_1, r_1], [l_2, r_2], \dots, [l_n, r_n]]$$$. You have to remove the minimum possible number of elements from this array so that the resulting array is beautiful.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 1000$$$) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 2000$$$) — the number of segments in the array. Then, $$$n$$$ lines follow, the $$$i$$$-th of them contains two integers $$$l_i$$$ and $$$r_i$$$ ($$$0 \le l_i \le r_i \le 10^9$$$) denoting the $$$i$$$-th segment.

Additional constraint on the input: the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2000$$$.

## Output

For each test case, print one integer — the minimum number of elements you have to remove so that the resulting array is beautiful.

## Note

In the first test case of the example, it is enough to delete the $$$5$$$-th element of the array of segments. Then you get the array $$$[[2, 4], [9, 12], [2, 4], [7, 7], [10, 13], [6, 8]]$$$, which is beautiful.

In the second test case of the example, you can delete the $$$1$$$-st, $$$3$$$-rd and $$$4$$$-th element of the array. Then you get the array $$$[[2, 8], [5, 6]]$$$, which is beautiful.

In the third test case of the example, you have to delete the whole array.

# 线段对

两个线段 $$$[l_1, r_1]$$$ 和 $$$[l_2, r_2]$$$ 相交，当且仅当存在至少一个 $$$x$$$ 使得 $$$l_1 \le x \le r_1$$$ 且 $$$l_2 \le x \le r_2$$$。

一个线段数组 $$$[[l_1, r_1], [l_2, r_2], \dots, [l_k, r_k]]$$$ 被称为美丽的，如果 $$$k$$$ 是偶数，并且可以将该数组的元素分成 $$$\frac{k}{2}$$$ 对，使得：

- 数组的每个元素恰好属于其中一个对；

- 每对中的线段彼此相交；

- 不同对中的线段不相交。

例如，数组 $$$[[2, 4], [9, 12], [2, 4], [7, 7], [10, 13], [6, 8]]$$$ 是美丽的，因为可以按如下方式组成 $$$3$$$ 对：

- 数组的第一个元素（线段 $$$[2, 4]$$$）和数组的第三个元素（线段 $$$[2, 4]$$$）；

- 数组的第二个元素（线段 $$$[9, 12]$$$）和数组的第五个元素（线段 $$$[10, 13]$$$）；

- 数组的第四个元素（线段 $$$[7, 7]$$$）和数组的第六个元素（线段 $$$[6, 8]$$$）。

如你所见，每一对中的线段都相交，而不同对的线段之间不相交。

给定一个由 $$$n$$$ 个线段 $$$[[l_1, r_1], [l_2, r_2], \dots, [l_n, r_n]]$$$ 组成的数组。你必须从该数组中删除尽可能少的元素，使得结果数组是美丽的。

## 输入格式

在第一个样例中，好对为 \((1,2)\) 和 \((2,3)\)。

在第二个样例中，好对为 \((1,2)\)、\((1,3)\) 和 \((2,3)\)。

对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数——为了使结果数组是美丽的，你必须移除的最少元素数量。

# Monocarp and a Strategic Game

Monocarp plays a strategic computer game in which he develops a city. The city is inhabited by creatures of four different races — humans, elves, orcs, and dwarves.

Each inhabitant of the city has a happiness value, which is an integer. It depends on how many creatures of different races inhabit the city. Specifically, the happiness of each inhabitant is $$$0$$$ by default; it increases by $$$1$$$ for each other creature of the same race and decreases by $$$1$$$ for each creature of a hostile race. Humans are hostile to orcs (and vice versa), and elves are hostile to dwarves (and vice versa).

At the beginning of the game, Monocarp's city is not inhabited by anyone. During the game, $$$n$$$ groups of creatures will come to his city, wishing to settle there. The $$$i$$$-th group consists of $$$a_i$$$ humans, $$$b_i$$$ orcs, $$$c_i$$$ elves, and $$$d_i$$$ dwarves. Each time, Monocarp can either accept the entire group of creatures into the city, or reject the entire group.

The game calculates Monocarp's score according to the following formula: $$$m + k$$$, where $$$m$$$ is the number of inhabitants in the city, and $$$k$$$ is the sum of the happiness values of all creatures in the city.

Help Monocarp earn the maximum possible number of points by the end of the game!

## Input

The first line contains an integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \leq n \leq 3 \cdot 10^{5}$$$) — the number of groups of creatures that come to Monocarp's city.

Then $$$n$$$ lines follow. The $$$i$$$-th of them contains four integers $$$a_i$$$, $$$b_i$$$, $$$c_i$$$, and $$$d_i$$$ ($$$0 \leq a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i \leq 10^{9}$$$) — the number of humans, orcs, elves and dwarves (respectively) in the $$$i$$$-th group.

## Output

Output a single number — the maximum score Monocarp can have by the end of the game. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $$$10^{-9}$$$. That is, if your answer is $$$a$$$, and the jury's answer is $$$b$$$, then the solution will be accepted if $$$\frac{|a-b|}{\max(1,|b|)} \le 10^{-9}$$$.

Note that the correct answer is always an integer, but sometimes it doesn't fit in $$$64$$$-bit integer types, so you are allowed to print it as a non-integer number.

## Note

In the first example, the best course of action is to accept all of the groups.

In the second example, the best course of action is to accept the groups $$$2$$$ and $$$3$$$, and decline the groups $$$1$$$ and $$$4$$$.
content.title: Monocarp and a Strategic Game

# Come Together

Bob and Carol hanged out with Alice the whole day, but now it's time to go home. Alice, Bob and Carol live on an infinite 2D grid in cells $$$A$$$, $$$B$$$, and $$$C$$$ respectively. Right now, all of them are in cell $$$A$$$.

If Bob (or Carol) is in some cell, he (she) can move to one of the neighboring cells. Two cells are called neighboring if they share a side. For example, the cell $$$(3, 5)$$$ has four neighboring cells: $$$(2, 5)$$$, $$$(4, 5)$$$, $$$(3, 6)$$$ and $$$(3, 4)$$$.

Bob wants to return to the cell $$$B$$$, Carol — to the cell $$$C$$$. Both of them want to go along the shortest path, i. e. along the path that consists of the minimum possible number of cells. But they would like to walk together as well.

What is the maximum possible number of cells that Bob and Carol can walk together if each of them walks home using one of the shortest paths?

## Input

The first line contains the single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains two integers $$$x_A$$$ and $$$y_A$$$ ($$$1 \le x_A, y_A \le 10^8$$$) — the position of cell $$$A$$$, where both Bob and Carol are right now.

The second line contains two integers $$$x_B$$$ and $$$y_B$$$ ($$$1 \le x_B, y_B \le 10^8$$$) — the position of cell $$$B$$$ (Bob's house).

The third line contains two integers $$$x_C$$$ and $$$y_C$$$ ($$$1 \le x_C, y_C \le 10^8$$$) — the position of cell $$$C$$$ (Carol's house).

Additional constraint on the input: the cells $$$A$$$, $$$B$$$, and $$$C$$$ are pairwise distinct in each test case.

## Output

For each test case, print the single integer — the maximum number of cells Bob and Carol can walk together if each of them goes home along one of the shortest paths.

## Note

In all pictures, red color denotes cells belonging only to Bob's path, light blue color — cells belonging only to Carol's path, and dark blue color — cells belonging to both paths.

# Strong Password

Monocarp finally got the courage to register on ForceCoders. He came up with a handle but is still thinking about the password.

He wants his password to be as strong as possible, so he came up with the following criteria:

- the length of the password should be exactly $$$m$$$;

- the password should only consist of digits from $$$0$$$ to $$$9$$$;

- the password should not appear in the password database (given as a string $$$s$$$) as a subsequence (not necessarily contiguous).

Monocarp also came up with two strings of length $$$m$$$: $$$l$$$ and $$$r$$$, both consisting only of digits from $$$0$$$ to $$$9$$$. He wants the $$$i$$$-th digit of his password to be between $$$l_i$$$ and $$$r_i$$$, inclusive.

Does there exist a password that fits all criteria?

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of testcases.

The first line of each testcase contains a string $$$s$$$ ($$$1 \le |s| \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$), consisting only of digits from $$$0$$$ to $$$9$$$ — the password database.

The second line contains a single integer $$$m$$$ ($$$1 \le m \le 10$$$) — the required length of the password.

The third line contains a string $$$l$$$ ($$$|l| = m$$$), consisting only of digits from $$$0$$$ to $$$9$$$ — the lower restriction on each digit.

The fourth line contains a string $$$r$$$ ($$$|r| = m$$$), consisting only of digits from $$$0$$$ to $$$9$$$ — the upper restriction on each digit. $$$l_i \le r_i$$$ for all $$$i$$$ from $$$1$$$ to $$$m$$$.

The sum of lengths of $$$s$$$ over all testcases doesn't exceed $$$3 \cdot 10^5$$$.

## Output

For each testcase, print "`YES`" if there exists a password that fits all criteria. Print "`NO`" otherwise.

## Note

In the first testcase, Monocarp can choose password "`50`". It doesn't appear in $$$s$$$ as a subsequence.

In the second testcase, all combinations of three digits, each of them being from $$$1$$$ to $$$4$$$, fit the criteria on $$$l$$$ and $$$r$$$. However, all of them appear in $$$s$$$ as subsequences. For example, "`314`" appears at positions $$$[3, 5, 12]$$$ and "`222`" appears at positions $$$[2, 6, 10]$$$.

In the third testcase, Monocarp can choose password "`4321`". Actually, that is the only password that fits the criteria on $$$l$$$ and $$$r$$$. Luckily, it doesn't appear in $$$s$$$ as a subsequence.

In the fourth testcase, only "`49`" and "`59`" fit the criteria on $$$l$$$ and $$$r$$$. Both of them appear in $$$s$$$ as subsequences.

In the fifth testcase, Monocarp can choose password "`11`".

# Evaluate RBS

You are given $$$2n$$$ tuples of values $$$(a, b, c)$$$, where $$$a$$$ and $$$b$$$ are positive integers and $$$c$$$ is a bracket '`(`' or '`)`'. Exactly $$$n$$$ tuples have $$$c = $$$'`(`' and the other $$$n$$$ tuples have $$$c =$$$ '`)`'.

You are asked to choose two positive values $$$x$$$ and $$$y$$$ ($$$x \gt 0$$$ and $$$y \gt 0$$$; not necessarily integers) and sort the tuples in the increasing value of $$$a \cdot x + b \cdot y$$$. If several tuples have the same value, you can place them in any order among themselves.

Is it possible to choose such $$$x$$$ and $$$y$$$ that taking brackets $$$c$$$ from the tuples in the resulting order produces a regular bracket sequence?

A regular bracket sequence is a bracket sequence that can be transformed into a correct arithmetic expression by inserting characters "`1`" and "`+`" between the original characters of the sequence.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 1500$$$) — the number of testcases.

The first line of each testcase contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 1500$$$).

The $$$i$$$-th of the next $$$2n$$$ lines contains two integers $$$a_i$$$ and $$$b_i$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i, b_i \le 10^6$$$) and a character $$$c_i$$$ ($$$c_i = $$$'`(`' or $$$c_i = $$$'`)`'). Exactly $$$n$$$ tuples have $$$c_i = $$$'`(`' and the other $$$n$$$ tuples have $$$c_i =$$$ '`)`'.

The sum of $$$n$$$ over all testcases doesn't exceed $$$1500$$$.

## Output

For each testcase, print "`YES`" if it's possible to choose such $$$x$$$ and $$$y$$$ that taking brackets $$$c$$$ from the tuples in the resulting order produces a regular bracket sequence. Otherwise, print "`NO`".

## Note

In the first testcase, you can choose $$$x = 10, y = 0.1$$$. The values for tuples will be $$$10 \cdot 1 + 0.1 \cdot 4 = 10.4$$$ and $$$10 \cdot 2 + 0.1 \cdot 3 = 20.3$$$. Thus, the first tuple will go first, then the second one, making the bracket sequence "`()`", which is regular.

In the second testcase, you can't choose positive $$$x$$$ and $$$y$$$ such that the opening brackets gets assigned a value less or equal to the value of the closing bracket.

In the fourth testcase, you can choose $$$x = 0.6, y = 0.55$$$. The bracket sequence is "`(()(()))`".

# ## 查询数组



Monocarp 有一个由整数组成的数组 $$$a$$$。最初，这个数组是空的。



Monocarp 对这个数组执行了三种类型的查询：



- 选择一个整数并将其追加到数组末尾。每次 Monocarp 执行这种类型的查询时，他写出一个字符 `+`；



- 从数组中移除最后一个元素。每次 Monocarp 执行这种类型的查询时，他写出一个字符 `-`。Monocarp 从不在空数组上执行此查询；



- 检查数组是否按非降序排序，即 $$$a_1 \le a_2 \le \dots \le a_k$$$，其中 $$$k$$$ 是当前数组中的元素个数。任何元素少于 $$$2$$$ 个的数组都被视为已排序。如果 Monocarp 执行该查询时数组已排序，他写出一个字符 `1`。否则，他写出一个字符 `0`。



给定一个由 $$$q$$$ 个字符 `0`、`1`、`+` 和/或 `-` 组成的序列 $$$s$$$。这些是 Monocarp 写出的字符，按照他写出的确切顺序给出。



你必须检查这个序列是否一致，即 Monocarp 是否可能执行这些查询，使得他写出的字符序列恰好是 $$$s$$$。



## 输入



输入的第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$（$$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$）—— 测试用例的数量。



每个测试用例由一行组成，包含字符串 $$$s$$$（$$$1 \le |s| \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$）。该字符串由字符 `0`、`1`、`+` 和/或 `-` 组成。这是 Monocarp 按照他写出的顺序写出的字符序列。



输入的附加约束：



- 对于 $$$s$$$ 的每个前缀，其中字符 `+` 的数量不少于其中字符 `-` 的数量。换句话说，如果 Monocarp 实际执行了这些查询，他永远不会尝试从空数组中移除最后一个元素；



- 所有测试用例中 $$$|s|$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。



## 输出



对于每个测试用例，如果 Monocarp 可能执行这些查询，使得他写出的字符序列恰好是 $$$s$$$，则输出 `YES`。否则，输出 `NO`。



你可以以任意大小写输出每个字母。



## 注意



在第一个测试用例中，Monocarp 可以执行以下查询序列：

- 加入整数 $$$13$$$；

- 加入整数 $$$37$$$；

- 检查当前数组 $$$[13, 37]$$$ 是否按非降序排列（它确实是有序的）。

在第五个测试用例中，Monocarp 可以执行以下查询序列：

- 加入整数 $$$3$$$；

- 加入整数 $$$2$$$；

- 检查当前数组 $$$[3, 2]$$$ 是否有序（它没有）；

- 移除最后一个元素；

- 加入整数 $$$3$$$；

- 检查当前数组 $$$[3, 3]$$$ 是否有序（它确实有序）；

- 移除最后一个元素；

- 加入整数 $$$-5$$$；

- 检查当前数组 $$$[3, -5]$$$ 是否有序（它没有）。

在示例测试的所有其他测试用例中，Monocarp 不可能在按照题目描述执行查询时写出序列 $$$s$$$。

# Four Suits

The game of Berland poker is played as follows. There are $$$n+1$$$ people: $$$n$$$ players, numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$, and the dealer. The dealer has a deck which contains cards of four different suits (the number of cards of each suit is not necessarily the same); the number of cards in the deck is divisible by $$$n$$$. The dealer gives all cards to the players, so that every player receives the same number of cards, and the whole deck is used.

After the cards are dealt, every player chooses one of four suits (independently) and discards all cards from their hand which do not belong to their chosen suit. The winner of the game is the player with the maximum number of cards left in their hand. The number of points the winner receives is $$$x - y$$$, where $$$x$$$ is the number of cards in the winner's hand, and $$$y$$$ is the maximum number of cards among all other players; everyone else receives $$$0$$$ points. Note that it means that if there are multiple players with the maximum number of cards, everyone receives $$$0$$$ points.

Since every player wants to maximize their odds to win, they will choose a suit with the maximum number of cards in their hand.

Monocarp is the dealer. He has already given some cards to the players; the $$$i$$$-th player received $$$a_{i,j}$$$ cards of suit $$$j$$$. Note that the number of cards in players' hands don't have to be the same at this moment. Monocarp has $$$b_1, b_2, b_3, b_4$$$ cards of suit $$$1, 2, 3, 4$$$ respectively left in his deck. He has to give them to the players so that, after all cards are dealt, every player has the same number of cards.

For each player, calculate the maximum number of points they can receive among all ways to deal the remaining cards according to the rules of the game.

## Input

The first line of the input contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 5 \cdot 10^4$$$) — the number of players.

Then $$$n$$$ lines follow. The $$$i$$$-th of them contains four integers $$$a_{i,1}, a_{i,2}, a_{i,3}, a_{i,4}$$$ ($$$0 \le a_{i,j} \le 10^6$$$), where $$$a_{i,j}$$$ is the number of cards of the $$$j$$$-th suit that the $$$i$$$-th player currently has.

The last line contains $$$4$$$ integers $$$b_1, b_2, b_3, b_4$$$ ($$$0 \le b_j \le 10^6$$$), where $$$b_j$$$ is the number of cards of the $$$j$$$-th suit Monocarp has to deal yet.

Additional constraint on the input: it is possible to deal all of the remaining cards so that every player has the same number of cards.

## Output

Print $$$n$$$ integers. The $$$i$$$-th of them should be the maximum number of points the $$$i$$$-th player can get among all possible ways to deal the remaining cards.

# 四种花色

Berland 扑克游戏规则如下。共有 $$$n+1$$$ 人：编号从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$ 的 $$$n$$$ 名玩家，以及发牌者。发牌者有一副牌，包含四种不同花色的牌（每种花色的牌数不一定相同）；牌堆中的牌数是 $$$n$$$ 的倍数。发牌者把所有牌发给玩家，使得每名玩家收到相同数量的牌，并且整副牌都被用完。

发牌后，每名玩家（独立地）选择四种花色之一，并弃掉手中所有不属于所选花色的牌。手中剩余牌数最多的玩家获胜。获胜者获得的分数为 $$$x - y$$$，其中 $$$x$$$ 是获胜者手中的牌数，$$$y$$$ 是所有其他玩家中最大的牌数；其他所有人获得 $$$0$$$ 分。注意，这意味着如果有多名玩家并列拥有最大牌数，则所有人都获得 $$$0$$$ 分。

由于每名玩家都想最大化自己获胜的机会，他们会选择自己手中牌数最多的花色。

Monocarp 是发牌者。他已经把一些牌发给了玩家；第 $$$i$$$ 名玩家收到了花色 $$$j$$$ 的 $$$a_{i,j}$$$ 张牌。注意，此时玩家手中的牌数不必相同。Monocarp 的牌堆中还剩下花色分别为 $$$1, 2, 3, 4$$$ 的 $$$b_1, b_2, b_3, b_4$$$ 张牌。他必须把它们发给玩家，使得在所有牌发完后，每名玩家都有相同数量的牌。

对于每名玩家，计算在按照游戏规则分配剩余牌的所有方式中，他们最多能获得的分数。

## 输入

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$（$$$2 \le n \le 5 \cdot 10^4$$$）——玩家数量。

接下来有 $$$n$$$ 行。其中第 $$$i$$$ 行包含四个整数 $$$a_{i,1}, a_{i,2}, a_{i,3}, a_{i,4}$$$（$$$0 \le a_{i,j} \le 10^6$$$），其中 $$$a_{i,j}$$$ 是第 $$$i$$$ 名玩家当前拥有的第 $$$j$$$ 种花色的牌数。

最后一行包含 $$$4$$$ 个整数 $$$b_1, b_2, b_3, b_4$$$（$$$0 \le b_j \le 10^6$$$），其中 $$$b_j$$$ 是 Monocarp 还需要发出的第 $$$j$$$ 种花色的牌数。

输入的附加约束：可以分配所有剩余的牌，使得每名玩家都有相同数量的牌。

## 输出

输出 $$$n$$$ 个整数。其中第 $$$i$$$ 个应当是第 $$$i$$$ 名玩家在分配剩余牌的所有可能方式中最多能获得的分数。

# Rigged!

Monocarp organizes a weightlifting competition. There are $$$n$$$ athletes participating in the competition, the $$$i$$$-th athlete has strength $$$s_i$$$ and endurance $$$e_i$$$. The $$$1$$$-st athlete is Monocarp's friend Polycarp, and Monocarp really wants Polycarp to win.

The competition will be conducted as follows. The jury will choose a positive (greater than zero) integer $$$w$$$, which denotes the weight of the barbell that will be used in the competition. The goal for each athlete is to lift the barbell as many times as possible. The athlete who lifts the barbell the most amount of times will be declared the winner (if there are multiple such athletes — there's no winner).

If the barbell's weight $$$w$$$ is strictly greater than the strength of the $$$i$$$-th athlete $$$s_i$$$, then the $$$i$$$-th athlete will be unable to lift the barbell even one single time. Otherwise, the $$$i$$$-th athlete will be able to lift the barbell, and the number of times he does it will be equal to his endurance $$$e_i$$$.

For example, suppose there are $$$4$$$ athletes with parameters $$$s_1 = 7, e_1 = 4$$$; $$$s_2 = 9, e_2 = 3$$$; $$$s_3 = 4, e_3 = 6$$$; $$$s_4 = 2, e_4 = 2$$$. If the weight of the barbell is $$$5$$$, then:

- the first athlete will be able to lift the barbell $$$4$$$ times;

- the second athlete will be able to lift the barbell $$$3$$$ times;

- the third athlete will be unable to lift the barbell;

- the fourth athlete will be unable to lift the barbell.

Monocarp wants to choose $$$w$$$ in such a way that Polycarp (the $$$1$$$-st athlete) wins the competition. Help him to choose the value of $$$w$$$, or report that it is impossible.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 100$$$) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 100$$$) — the number of athletes. Then $$$n$$$ lines follow, the $$$i$$$-th of them contains two integers $$$s_i$$$ and $$$e_i$$$ ($$$1 \le s_i \le 10^9$$$; $$$1 \le e_i \le 100$$$) — the strength and the endurance of the $$$i$$$-th athlete.

## Output

For each test case, print the answer as follows:

- if the answer exists, print one integer — the value of $$$w$$$ meeting the constraints. The integer you print should satisfy $$$1 \le w \le 10^9$$$. It can be shown that if the answer exists, at least one such value of $$$w$$$ exists as well. If there are multiple answers, you can print any of them;

- otherwise, print one integer $$$-1$$$.

## Note

The first test case of the example is described in the statement.

Monocarp 组织了一场举重比赛。共有 $$$n$$$ 名运动员参加比赛，第 $$$i$$$ 名运动员的力量为 $$$s_i$$$，耐力为 $$$e_i$$$。第 $$$1$$$ 名运动员是 Monocarp 的朋友 Polycarp，Monocarp 非常希望 Polycarp 获胜。

# Interactive Game with Coloring

This is an interactive problem. Remember to flush your output while communicating with the testing program. You may use `fflush(stdout)` in C++, `system.out.flush()` in Java, `stdout.flush()` in Python or `flush(output)` in Pascal to flush the output. If you use some other programming language, consult its documentation. You may also refer to the guide on interactive problems: [https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/45307](https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/45307).

You are given a tree on $$$n$$$ vertices; vertex $$$1$$$ is the root of the tree. For every $$$i \in [2, n]$$$, the parent of the $$$i$$$-th vertex is $$$p_i$$$, and $$$p_i \lt i$$$.

You have to color all edges of the tree using the minimum possible number of colors such that you can win the game on that tree (every edge should be painted into exactly one color).

The game we're going to play will be conducted as follows. After you paint the edges and print their colors, the jury will place a chip into one of the vertices of the tree (except for the root). Your goal is to move this chip to the root in exactly $$$d$$$ moves, where $$$d$$$ is the distance from the root to that vertex (the distance is equal to the number of edges on the path). If the chip reaches the root in $$$d$$$ moves, you win. Otherwise, you lose.

The jury won't tell you where the chip is located. You won't even know the value of $$$d$$$ in advance. However, at the start of each move, you will be told how many edges of each color are incident to the current vertex (this includes both the edge leading up the tree and the edges leading away from the root). You have to choose one of these colors, and the chip will be moved along the edge of the chosen color (if there are multiple edges with that color incident to the current vertex, the jury gets to choose one of them). After the chip is moved, you will be told the same information about the current vertex again, and the game continues, until you either reach the root, or you make $$$d$$$ moves without reaching the root.

The interactor for this problem is adaptive. It means that both the starting vertex and the current vertex are not fixed and may change "on the run" depending on the output of your program. However, the state of the game will always be consistent with the information you are given: there will always be at least one starting vertex and at least one path of your chip from that vertex consistent with both the information about the colors you receive and the colors you've chosen during the moves.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$3 \le n \le 100$$$) — the number of vertices in the tree.

The second line contains $$$n-1$$$ integers $$$p_2, p_3, \dots, p_n$$$ ($$$1 \le p_i \lt i$$$), where $$$p_i$$$ is the parent of the $$$i$$$-th vertex in the tree.

## Interaction

First, you have to print the coloring of the edges you've chosen as follows:

- in the first line, print one integer $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le k \le n - 1$$$) — the number of colors you are using;

- in the second line, print $$$n-1$$$ integers $$$c_2, c_3, \dots, c_n$$$ ($$$1 \le c_i \le k$$$), where $$$c_i$$$ should be the color of the edge connecting $$$p_i$$$ with $$$i$$$.

Then, the game begins. At the start of each move, the jury program prints one of the following:

- one integer $$$1$$$ on a separate line, indicating that the chip has reached the root and you won;

- one integer $$$-1$$$ on a separate line, indicating that either you didn't reach the root in $$$d$$$ moves and lost, or you have done something incorrect (either the coloring you provided didn't meet the constraints, or your previous move is impossible);

- or one integer $$$0$$$ on a separate line, followed by a line containing $$$k$$$ integers $$$e_1, e_2, \dots, e_k$$$, where $$$e_i$$$ is the number of edges with color $$$i$$$ incident to the current vertex.

If you receive $$$1$$$ or $$$-1$$$, your program should terminate immediately, otherwise the verdict for your submission may be undefined. If you receive $$$0$$$ followed by $$$k$$$ integers $$$e_1, e_2, \dots, e_k$$$, you have to print one integer indicating the color you choose during the move (of course, $$$e_i$$$ for that color should not be equal to $$$0$$$).

Don't forget to flush the output every time you print something!

## Note

In the first example, every vertex from $$$2$$$ to $$$n$$$ is connected to the root. So, we can paint all edges into the same color $$$1$$$, and when the game starts, there will be only one edge incident to the current vertex (and it will lead to the root).

In the second example, the tree is a path of $$$4$$$ vertices. We have to paint its edges into different colors, because it can be shown that we don't have a winning strategy with just two colors.

# 与着色游戏的交互题

这是一道交互题。在与测试程序通信时，请记得刷新输出。你可以使用 C++ 中的 `fflush(stdout)`、Java 中的 `system.out.flush()`、Python 中的 `stdout.flush()` 或 Pascal 中的 `flush(output)` 来刷新输出。如果你使用其他编程语言，请查阅其文档。你也可以参考关于交互题的指南：[https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/45307](https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/45307)。

给定一棵有 $$$n$$$ 个顶点的树；顶点 $$$1$$$ 是树的根。对于每个 $$$i \in [2, n]$$$，第 $$$i$$$ 个顶点的父节点是 $$$p_i$$$，且 $$$p_i \lt i$$$。

你必须使用尽可能少的颜色为树的所有边着色，使得你能够在该树上赢得游戏（每条边都应恰好涂成一种颜色）。

我们将要进行的游戏如下进行。在你为边涂色并打印它们的颜色后，评测方会将一个筹码放在树的某个顶点上（根除外）。你的目标是在恰好 $$$d$$$ 步内将这个筹码移动到根，其中 $$$d$$$ 是从根到该顶点的距离（距离等于路径上的边数）。如果筹码在 $$$d$$$ 步内到达根，你就赢了。否则，你就输了。

评测方不会告诉你筹码在哪里。你甚至不会提前知道 $$$d$$$ 的值。然而，在每一步开始时，你会被告知当前顶点关联的每种颜色的边数（这包括通向树上的边和远离根的边）。你必须选择其中一种颜色，筹码将沿着所选颜色的边移动（如果当前顶点关联有多条该颜色的边，评测方可以选择其中一条）。筹码移动后，你会再次被告知当前顶点的相同信息，游戏继续，直到你到达根，或者你进行了 $$$d$$$ 步仍未到达根。

本题的交互器是自适应的。这意味着起始顶点和当前顶点都不是固定的，并且可能根据你程序的输出“在运行中”改变。然而，游戏状态将始终与你收到的信息一致：始终至少存在一个起始顶点，以及至少一条你的筹码从该顶点出发的路径，与你收到的颜色信息以及你在移动过程中选择的颜色都一致。

## 输入

第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$（$$$3 \le n \le 100$$$）——树中的顶点数。

第二行包含 $$$n-1$$$ 个整数 $$$p_2, p_3, \dots, p_n$$$（$$$1 \le p_i \lt i$$$），其中 $$$p_i$$$ 是树中第 $$$i$$$ 个顶点的父节点。

## 交互

首先，你必须按如下方式输出你所选边的染色方案：

- 在第一行输出一个整数$$$k$$$（$$$1 \le k \le n - 1$$$）——你使用的颜色数量；

- 在第二行输出$$$n-1$$$个整数$$$c_2, c_3, \dots, c_n$$$（$$$1 \le c_i \le k$$$），其中$$$c_i$$$应该是连接$$$p_i$$$与$$$i$$$的边的颜色。

然后，游戏开始。在每一步开始时，评测程序会输出以下之一：

- 在单独一行输出一个整数$$$1$$$，表示棋子已经到达根节点，你赢了；

- 在单独一行输出一个整数$$$-1$$$，表示你要么在$$$d$$$步内没有到达根节点而失败，要么你做了不正确的事情（要么你提供的染色不满足约束，要么你上一步的移动是不可能的）；

- 或者在单独一行输出一个整数$$$0$$$，随后一行包含$$$k$$$个整数$$$e_1, e_2, \dots, e_k$$$，其中$$$e_i$$$是与当前顶点相邻且颜色为$$$i$$$的边的数量。

如果你收到$$$1$$$或$$$-1$$$，你的程序应当立即终止，否则你的提交的判定结果可能未定义。如果你收到$$$0$$$后跟$$$k$$$个整数$$$e_1, e_2, \dots, e_k$$$，你必须输出一个整数，表示你在该步中选择的颜色（当然，该颜色的$$$e_i$$$不应等于$$$0$$$）。

每次输出内容后不要忘记刷新输出！

## 注意

在第一个例子中，从$$$2$$$到$$$n$$$的每个顶点都与根节点相连。因此，我们可以把所有边都染成同一种颜色$$$1$$$，当游戏开始时，与当前顶点相邻的边将只有一条（并且它通向根节点）。

在第二个例子中，树是一条包含$$$4$$$个顶点的路径。我们必须把它的边染成不同的颜色，因为可以证明，只用两种颜色我们没有必胜策略。

# # 最后的幸存者



在一款电子游戏中有 $$$n$$$ 个英雄。每个英雄都有一定的生命值 $$$h$$$ 和初始护甲值 $$$a$$$。设护甲的当前值为 $$$a_{\mathit{cur}}$$$，初始时等于 $$$a$$$。



 当对一个英雄造成 $$$x$$$ 点伤害时，会发生以下情况：如果 $$$x \lt a_{\mathit{cur}}$$$，则从 $$$a_{\mathit{cur}}$$$ 中减去 $$$x$$$；否则，从 $$$h$$$ 中减去 $$$1$$$，并将 $$$a_{\mathit{cur}}$$$ 重新赋值给 $$$a$$$。



 在游戏开始时，你选择一个值 $$$x$$$（一个严格大于 $$$0$$$ 的整数，可以任意大）。然后你按回合持续攻击所有英雄：在一个回合中，你对所有存活的英雄造成 $$$x$$$ 点伤害。当一个英雄的生命值变为 $$$0$$$ 时，该英雄死亡。当所有英雄都死亡时，游戏结束。



 最后一个死亡的英雄获得的分数等于他作为唯一存活英雄的回合数。其他英雄获得 $$$0$$$ 分。特别地，如果最后一个回合结束时有多名英雄同时死亡，那么每个英雄都获得 $$$0$$$ 分。



 游戏对每一个可能的 $$$x$$$（从 $$$1$$$ 到无穷大）进行。每局游戏之间分数会重置。每个英雄所能获得的最高分数是多少？





##  输入



第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$（$$$1 \le t \le 10$$$）——测试用例的数量。



 每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$（$$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$）——英雄的数量。



 第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$h_1, h_2, \dots, h_n$$$（$$$1 \le h_i \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$）——每个英雄的生命值。



 第三行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$（$$$1 \le a_i \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$）——每个英雄的初始护甲值。





##  输出



对于每个测试用例，输出 $$$n$$$ 个整数——在针对每一个可能的 $$$x$$$ 所进行的游戏中，每个英雄所能获得的最高分数。





##  提示



在第一个测试用例中，对于 $$$x = 1$$$ 的游戏过程如下：





-  所有回合之前：英雄们拥有 $$$h = [3, 1, 2]$$$，$$$a_{\mathit{cur}} = [3, 11, 5]$$$；





-  第 $$$1$$$ 回合：对每个英雄造成 $$$1$$$ 点伤害：$$$h$$$ 保持为 $$$[3, 1, 2]$$$，$$$a_{\mathit{cur}}$$$ 变为 $$$[2, 10, 4]$$$；





-  第 $$$2$$$ 回合：$$$h = [3, 1, 2]$$$，$$$a_{\mathit{cur}} = [1, 9, 3]$$$；

- 第 $$$3$$$ 回合：第一名英雄护甲耗尽，因此失去一点生命值：$$$h = [2, 1, 2]$$$，$$$a_{\mathit{cur}} = [3, 8, 2]$$$；

- ...

- 第 $$$9$$$ 回合：第一名英雄死亡，因为其生命值降为 $$$0$$$：$$$h = [0, 1, 1]$$$，$$$a_{\mathit{cur}} = [0, 2, 1]$$$；

- 第 $$$10$$$ 回合：第三名英雄死亡：$$$h = [0, 1, 0]$$$，$$$a_{\mathit{cur}} = [0, 1, 0]$$$；

- 第 $$$11$$$ 回合：第二名英雄死亡：$$$h = [0, 0, 0]$$$，$$$a_{\mathit{cur}} = [0, 0, 0]$$$。

第二名英雄是最后死亡的英雄，并且他在一个回合内是唯一存活的英雄。因此，他因该局获得 $$$1$$$ 分。

$$$x = 4$$$ 的游戏过程如下：

- 第 $$$1$$$ 回合：$$$h = [2, 1, 2]$$$，$$$a_{\mathit{cur}} = [3, 7, 1]$$$；

- 第 $$$2$$$ 回合：$$$h = [1, 1, 1]$$$，$$$a_{\mathit{cur}} = [3, 3, 5]$$$；

- 第 $$$3$$$ 回合：$$$h = [0, 0, 1]$$$，$$$a_{\mathit{cur}} = [0, 0, 1]$$$；

- 第 $$$4$$$ 回合：$$$h = [0, 0, 0]$$$，$$$a_{\mathit{cur}} = [0, 0, 0]$$$；

第三名英雄是最后死亡的英雄，并且他在一个回合内是唯一存活的英雄。

# Infinite Card Game

Monocarp and Bicarp are playing a card game. Each card has two parameters: an attack value and a defence value. A card $$$s$$$ beats another card $$$t$$$ if the attack of $$$s$$$ is strictly greater than the defence of $$$t$$$.

Monocarp has $$$n$$$ cards, the $$$i$$$-th of them has an attack value of $$$\mathit{ax}_i$$$ and a defence value of $$$\mathit{ay}_i$$$. Bicarp has $$$m$$$ cards, the $$$j$$$-th of them has an attack value of $$$\mathit{bx}_j$$$ and a defence value of $$$\mathit{by}_j$$$.

On the first move, Monocarp chooses one of his cards and plays it. Bicarp has to respond with his own card that beats that card. After that, Monocarp has to respond with a card that beats Bicarp's card. After that, it's Bicarp's turn, and so forth.

After a card is beaten, it returns to the hand of the player who played it. It implies that each player always has the same set of cards to play as at the start of the game. The game ends when the current player has no cards that beat the card which their opponent just played, and the current player loses.

If the game lasts for $$$100^{500}$$$ moves, it's declared a draw.

Both Monocarp and Bicarp play optimally. That is, if a player has a winning strategy regardless of his opponent's moves, he plays for a win. Otherwise, if he has a drawing strategy, he plays for a draw.

You are asked to calculate three values:

- the number of Monocarp's starting moves that result in a win for Monocarp;

- the number of Monocarp's starting moves that result in a draw;

- the number of Monocarp's starting moves that result in a win for Bicarp.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains an integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of cards Monocarp has.

The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$\mathit{ax}_1, \mathit{ax}_2, \dots, \mathit{ax}_n$$$ ($$$1 \le \mathit{ax}_i \le 10^6$$$) — the attack values of Monocarp's cards.

The third line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$\mathit{ay}_1, \mathit{ay}_2, \dots, \mathit{ay}_n$$$ ($$$1 \le \mathit{ay}_i \le 10^6$$$) — the defence values of Monocarp's cards.

The fourth line contains a single integer $$$m$$$ ($$$1 \le m \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of cards Bicarp has.

The fifth line contains $$$m$$$ integers $$$\mathit{bx}_1, \mathit{bx}_2, \dots, \mathit{bx}_m$$$ ($$$1 \le \mathit{bx}_j \le 10^6$$$) — the attack values of Bicarp's cards.

The sixth line contains $$$m$$$ integers $$$\mathit{by}_1, \mathit{by}_2, \dots, \mathit{by}_m$$$ ($$$1 \le \mathit{by}_j \le 10^6$$$) — the defence values of Bicarp's cards.

Additional constraints on the input: the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases doesn't exceed $$$3 \cdot 10^5$$$, the sum of $$$m$$$ over all test cases doesn't exceed $$$3 \cdot 10^5$$$.

## Output

For each test case, print three integers:

- the number of Monocarp's starting moves that result in a win for Monocarp;

- the number of Monocarp's starting moves that result in a draw;

- the number of Monocarp's starting moves that result in a win for Bicarp.

# 无限卡牌游戏

Monocarp 和 Bicarp 正在玩一个卡牌游戏。每张卡牌有两个参数：攻击值和防御值。一张卡牌 $$$s$$$ 击败另一张卡牌 $$$t$$$，当且仅当 $$$s$$$ 的攻击值严格大于 $$$t$$$ 的防御值。

Monocarp 有 $$$n$$$ 张卡牌，其中第 $$$i$$$ 张的攻击值为 $$$\mathit{ax}_i$$$，防御值为 $$$\mathit{ay}_i$$$。Bicarp 有 $$$m$$$ 张卡牌，其中第 $$$j$$$ 张的攻击值为 $$$\mathit{bx}_j$$$，防御值为 $$$\mathit{by}_j$$$。

第一步，Monocarp 选择他的一张卡牌并打出。Bicarp 必须用自己的一张能击败该卡牌的卡牌来回应。之后，Monocarp 必须用一张能击败 Bicarp 卡牌的卡牌来回应。再之后轮到 Bicarp，依此类推。

一张卡牌被击败后，会回到打出它的玩家手中。这意味着每个玩家始终拥有与游戏开始时相同的可打出的卡牌集合。当当前玩家没有卡牌能击败对手刚打出的卡牌时，游戏结束，当前玩家失败。

如果游戏持续 $$$100^{500}$$$ 步，则宣布为平局。

Monocarp 和 Bicarp 都采取最优策略。也就是说，如果一名玩家无论对手如何行动都有获胜策略，他就会争取获胜。否则，如果他有平局策略，他就会争取平局。

你需要计算三个值：

- Monocarp 的起始行动中导致 Monocarp 获胜的数量；

- Monocarp 的起始行动中导致平局的数量；

- Monocarp 的起始行动中导致 Bicarp 获胜的数量。

## 输入

第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$（$$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$（$$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$）——Monocarp 拥有的卡牌数量。

第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$\mathit{ax}_1, \mathit{ax}_2, \dots, \mathit{ax}_n$$$（$$$1 \le \mathit{ax}_i \le 10^6$$$）——Monocarp 的卡牌的攻击值。

第三行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$\mathit{ay}_1, \mathit{ay}_2, \dots, \mathit{ay}_n$$$（$$$1 \le \mathit{ay}_i \le 10^6$$$）——Monocarp 的卡牌的防御值。

第四行包含一个整数 $$$m$$$（$$$1 \le m \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$）——Bicarp 拥有的卡牌数量。

第五行包含 $$$m$$$ 个整数 $$$\mathit{bx}_1, \mathit{bx}_2, \dots, \mathit{bx}_m$$$（$$$1 \le \mathit{bx}_j \le 10^6$$$）——Bicarp 的卡牌的攻击值。

第六行包含 $$$m$$$ 个整数 $$$\mathit{by}_1, \mathit{by}_2, \dots, \mathit{by}_m$$$（$$$1 \le \mathit{by}_j \le 10^6$$$）——Bicarp 的卡牌的防御值。

输入的额外约束：所有测试用例中 $$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$3 \cdot 10^5$$$，所有测试用例中 $$$m$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$3 \cdot 10^5$$$。

## 输出

对于每个测试用例，输出三个整数：

- Monocarp 的起始走法中导致 Monocarp 获胜的数量；

- Monocarp 的起始走法中导致平局的数量；

- Monocarp 的起始走法中导致 Bicarp 获胜的数量。

# Line Trip

有一条路，可以表示为一条数轴。你位于数轴上的点 $$$0$$$，并且你想从点 $$$0$$$ 前往点 $$$x$$$，然后返回点 $$$0$$$。

你开车出行，每行驶$$$1$$$单位距离消耗$$$1$$$升汽油。当你从点$$$0$$$出发时，你的车是满油的（其油箱装有最大可能量的燃料）。

有$$$n$$$个加油站，位于点$$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$。当你到达一个加油站时，你会给汽车加满油。注意，你只能在加油站加油，而在点$$$0$$$和$$$x$$$没有加油站。

你需要计算你汽车油箱的最小可能体积（以升为单位），使得你能够从点 $$$0$$$ 行驶到点 $$$x$$$，再返回点 $$$0$$$。

## 输入

第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$（$$$1 \le t \le 1000$$$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例由两行组成：

# Chip and Ribbon

There is a ribbon divided into $$$n$$$ cells, numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ from left to right. Initially, an integer $$$0$$$ is written in each cell.

Monocarp plays a game with a chip. The game consists of several turns. During the first turn, Monocarp places the chip in the $$$1$$$-st cell of the ribbon. During each turn except for the first turn, Monocarp does exactly one of the two following actions:

- move the chip to the next cell (i. e. if the chip is in the cell $$$i$$$, it is moved to the cell $$$i+1$$$). This action is impossible if the chip is in the last cell;

- choose any cell $$$x$$$ and teleport the chip into that cell. It is possible to choose the cell where the chip is currently located.

At the end of each turn, the integer written in the cell with the chip is increased by $$$1$$$.

Monocarp's goal is to make some turns so that the $$$1$$$-st cell contains the integer $$$c_1$$$, the $$$2$$$-nd cell contains the integer $$$c_2$$$, ..., the $$$n$$$-th cell contains the integer $$$c_n$$$. He wants to teleport the chip as few times as possible.

Help Monocarp calculate the minimum number of times he has to teleport the chip.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.

Each test case consists of two lines:

- the first line contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$);

- the second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$c_1, c_2, \dots, c_n$$$ ($$$0 \le c_i \le 10^9$$$; $$$c_1 \ge 1$$$).

It can be shown that under these constraints, it is always possible to make a finite amount of turns so that the integers in the cells match the sequence $$$c_1, c_2, \dots, c_n$$$.

Additional constraint on the input: the sum of values of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.

## Output

For each test case, print one integer — the minimum number of times Monocarp has to teleport the chip.

## Note

In the first test case of the example, Monocarp can perform the turns as follows:

- place the chip in the $$$1$$$-st cell; the numbers in the cells are $$$[1, 0, 0, 0]$$$;

- move the chip to the next ($$$2$$$-nd) cell; the numbers in the cells are $$$[1, 1, 0, 0]$$$;

- move the chip to the next ($$$3$$$-rd) cell; the numbers in the cells are $$$[1, 1, 1, 0]$$$;

- teleport the chip to the $$$2$$$-nd cell; the numbers in the cells are $$$[1, 2, 1, 0]$$$;

- move the chip to the next ($$$3$$$-rd) cell; the numbers in the cells are $$$[1, 2, 2, 0]$$$;

- move the chip to the next ($$$4$$$-th) cell; the numbers in the cells are $$$[1, 2, 2, 1]$$$.

# Yet Another Monster Fight

Vasya is a sorcerer that fights monsters. Again. There are $$$n$$$ monsters standing in a row, the amount of health points of the $$$i$$$-th monster is $$$a_i$$$.

Vasya is a very powerful sorcerer who knows many overpowered spells. In this fight, he decided to use a chain lightning spell to defeat all the monsters. Let's see how this spell works.

Firstly, Vasya chooses an index $$$i$$$ of some monster ($$$1 \le i \le n$$$) and the initial power of the spell $$$x$$$. Then the spell hits monsters exactly $$$n$$$ times, one hit per monster. The first target of the spell is always the monster $$$i$$$. For every target except for the first one, the chain lightning will choose a random monster who was not hit by the spell and is adjacent to one of the monsters that already was hit. So, each monster will be hit exactly once. The first monster hit by the spell receives $$$x$$$ damage, the second monster receives $$$(x-1)$$$ damage, the third receives $$$(x-2)$$$ damage, and so on.

Vasya wants to show how powerful he is, so he wants to kill all the monsters with a single chain lightning spell. The monster is considered dead if the damage he received is not less than the amount of its health points. On the other hand, Vasya wants to show he doesn't care that much, so he wants to choose the minimum initial power of the spell $$$x$$$ such that it kills all monsters, no matter which monster (among those who can get hit) gets hit on each step.

Of course, Vasya is a sorcerer, but the amount of calculations required to determine the optimal spell setup is way above his possibilities, so you have to help him find the minimum spell power required to kill all the monsters.

Note that Vasya chooses the initial target and the power of the spell, other things should be considered random and Vasya wants to kill all the monsters even in the worst possible scenario.

## Input

The first line of the input contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of monsters.

The second line of the input contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$), where $$$a_i$$$ is the amount of health points of the $$$i$$$-th monster.

## Output

Print one integer — the minimum spell power required to kill all the monsters if Vasya chooses the first target optimally, and the order of spell hits can be any possible within the given rules.

# Landscaping

You are appointed to a very important task: you are in charge of flattening one specific road.

The road can be represented as a polygonal line starting at $$$(0, 0)$$$, ending at $$$(n - 1, 0)$$$ and consisting of $$$n$$$ vertices (including starting and ending points). The coordinates of the $$$i$$$-th vertex of the polyline are $$$(i, a_i)$$$.

"Flattening" road is equivalent to choosing some line segment from $$$(0, y_0)$$$ to $$$(n - 1, y_1)$$$ such that all points of the polyline are below the chosen segment (or on the same height). Values $$$y_0$$$ and $$$y_1$$$ may be real.

You can imagine that the road has some dips and pits, and you start pouring pavement onto it until you make the road flat. Points $$$0$$$ and $$$n - 1$$$ have infinitely high walls, so pavement doesn't fall out of segment $$$[0, n - 1]$$$.

![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/63243ad80fc2fc355ed20867a93d66b6523e77e1.png)

The cost of flattening the road is equal to the area between the chosen segment and the polyline. You want to minimize the cost, that's why the flattened road is not necessary horizontal.

But there is a problem: your data may be too old, so you sent a person to measure new heights. The person goes from $$$0$$$ to $$$n - 1$$$ and sends you new heights $$$b_i$$$ of each vertex $$$i$$$ of the polyline.

Since measuring new heights may take a while, and you don't know when you'll be asked, calculate the minimum cost (and corresponding $$$y_0$$$ and $$$y_1$$$) to flatten the road after each new height $$$b_i$$$ you get.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$3 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of vertices of the polyline.

The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_0, a_1, \dots, a_{n - 1}$$$ ($$$0 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$; $$$a_0 = a_{n - 1} = 0$$$) — the heights of the corresponding vertices.

The third line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$b_0, b_1, \dots, b_{n - 1}$$$ ($$$0 \le b_i \le 10^9$$$; $$$b_0 = b_{n - 1} = 0$$$) — the new heights of the corresponding vertices.

## Output

Print $$$n$$$ numbers: as the $$$i$$$-th number ($$$0$$$-indexed) print $$$y_0 + y_1$$$ of the "best segment" (i. e. the sum of coordinates of the segment that gives the minimum cost) if you already know actual heights $$$b_0, \dots, b_i$$$.

If there are several "best segments", print the minimum possible $$$y_0 + y_1$$$ among them.

Your answer is considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $$$10^{-9}$$$.

Formally, let your answer be $$$x$$$, and the jury's answer be $$$y$$$. Your answer is accepted if and only if $$$\frac{|x - y|}{\max{(1, |y|)}} \le 10^{-9}$$$.

The first answer in the first example is shown on the picture above.

You can achieve the second answer with the following "best segment":

![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3bd58cb7a8e67390881853c3067eeeeff0ec2d91.png)

You can achieve the third answer using the following "best segment":

![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b4e4ffb246306d290e9d0f97d4e439e866039e2c.png)

You can achieve the fourth answer with the "best segment" shown below:

![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0334407d0b78761748f278867363f2e92e342516.png)

# 景观设计

你被分配了一项非常重要的任务：你负责平整一条特定的道路。

这条道路可以表示为一条折线，起点为$$$(0, 0)$$$，终点为$$$(n - 1, 0)$$$，由$$$n$$$个顶点组成（包括起点和终点）。折线第$$$i$$$个顶点的坐标为$$$(i, a_i)$$$。

“平整”道路等价于从$$$(0, y_0)$$$到$$$(n - 1, y_1)$$$中选择一条线段，使得折线的所有点都位于所选线段下方（或同一高度）。$$$y_0$$$和$$$y_1$$$的值可以是实数。

你可以想象这条道路有一些凹陷和坑洼，然后你开始在上面铺设路面，直到把道路铺平。$$$0$$$和$$$n - 1$$$处有无限高的墙，所以路面不会从线段$$$[0, n - 1]$$$中掉出去。

![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/63243ad80fc2fc355ed20867a93d66b6523e77e1.png)

平整道路的代价等于所选线段与折线之间的面积。你希望最小化代价，因此平整后的道路不一定是水平的。

但有一个问题：你的数据可能太旧了，所以你派了一个人去测量新的高度。这个人从$$$0$$$走到$$$n - 1$$$，并把折线每个顶点$$$i$$$的新高度$$$b_i$$$发送给你。

由于测量新高度可能需要一段时间，而你不知道什么时候会被询问，所以在每收到一个新高度$$$b_i$$$后，计算平整道路的最小代价（以及对应的$$$y_0$$$和$$$y_1$$$）。

## 输入

第一行包含一个整数$$$n$$$（$$$3 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$）——折线的顶点数。

第二行包含$$$n$$$个整数$$$a_0, a_1, \dots, a_{n - 1}$$$（$$$0 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$；$$$a_0 = a_{n - 1} = 0$$$）——对应顶点的高度。

第三行包含$$$n$$$个整数$$$b_0, b_1, \dots, b_{n - 1}$$$（$$$0 \le b_i \le 10^9$$$；$$$b_0 = b_{n - 1} = 0$$$）——对应顶点的新高度。

## 输出

输出$$$n$$$个数：第$$$i$$$个数（从$$$0$$$开始索引）输出“最佳线段”的$$$y_0 + y_1$$$（即给出最小代价的线段的坐标之和），此时你已经知道实际高度$$$b_0, \dots, b_i$$$。

如果有多个“最佳线段”，输出其中最小的$$$y_0 + y_1$$$。

如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过$$$10^{-9}$$$，则被认为是正确的。

形式化地说，设你的答案为$$$x$$$，评测答案$$$y$$$。当且仅当 $$$\frac{|x - y|}{\max{(1, |y|)}} \le 10^{-9}$$$ 时，你的答案才会被接受。
